* Help prepare monthly bank, vendor, and account reconciliations, flagging and following up on discrepancies
* Support the AP/AR cycle, including invoice coding, approvals tracking, and vendor queries
* Assist with the monthly close process under supervision (accruals, prepayments, basic schedules)
* Help maintain accurate, organized supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes
* Support ad hoc finance projects and administrative tasks as assigned by the team
* Supporting the team in the implementation of AI across finance operations


**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field


**Required Experience**

* No prior professional experience required; internships or academic projects in accounting/finance are a plus
* familiarity with accounting principles (debits/credits, journal entries, basic reconciliations)


**Required Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers
* working knowledge of Excel
* Eagerness to learn accounting systems and tools (e.g., Microsoft Business Central or similar ERP — training will be provided)
* Eagerness to support AI implementation in finance (e.g., agents or AI\-assisted workflows)
* Organized, able to manage multiple small tasks and deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions and escalating issues
* Team player with a proactive, can\-do attitude


**What We Offer**

* Direct mentorship from experienced accounting and finance professionals
* Hands\-on exposure to the full transaction\-to\-reporting cycle at a fast\-growing, global semiconductor company
* Hybrid working model


If you recognize yourself in the description above, and love to be part of a growing Company, are a good team player with an upbeat approach to life, we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!

Our client is an established Swiss financial institution with an international client base and activities spanning Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Treasury. Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================







Zurich is a leading multi\-line insurer that serves its customers in global and local markets. With about 55,000 employees, it provides a wide range of property and casualty, life insurance products and services in more than 215 countries and territories. Zurich's customers include individuals, small businesses, and mid\-sized and large companies, as well as multinational corporations.



Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================





Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?



In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine\-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI\-augmented enterprise.



We're looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future\-ready, cost\-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves \- in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.



You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.



We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.



If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.



Find out why Zurich Switzerland is among the "Top 3" companies in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security.







**What you will do**



* Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey
* Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event\-driven and AI\-augmented workflows
* Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust
* Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI\-augmented workflows \- ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer
* Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes






**What you bring**



* 7\+ years in software or security engineering \- ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry \- with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands\-on Keycloak experience
* Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent\-to\-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI\-augmented development (Copilot, , agentic workflows)
* Solid understanding of fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud\-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)
* Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade\-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written, is a plus

Talent Acquisition Consultant: ( )

Full time or part time: 80 \- 100%



Work location:



Hybrid work: up to 40%







We look forward to receiving your online application \- even without a cover letter.



You are welcome to convince us of your motivation in a personal meeting.







**Who we are**



Zurich is a strong brand \- more than 1\.4 million Swiss customers place their trust in our products and services. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, helping our customers in 210 countries and territories to understand and protect themselves from risk. In order to deliver our services, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting opportunities for further training \& development. As a Zurich employee you benefit from a multitude of advantages as well as a strong culture, characterized by acceptance, diversity and team spirit.



At Zurich, we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our purpose and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their full potential. We value and defend what is right and promote opportunities for equity among our professionals, regardless of gender, disability, LGBTQ \+, race, ethnicity, generations, belief, etc. Our talent acquisition and hiring processes respect this commitment daily. Join Zurich and be part of this culture.



Why has Zurich been successful for over 150 years? and become a part of it.

Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description:
Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!

In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.

In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that:
Every moment is pedagogical
Play is the foundation of learning
Learning happens throughout the whole day
Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround
Childrens interests and questions guide learning

Your core responsibilities:
Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities
Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses
Observe and document childrens learning and development
Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families
Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals
Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoors

Our daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.

We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.

Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027:
Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship
At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained.
At least level B2 in English language
Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly.

Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028:
Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language
Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland
Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre
Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis

We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.

We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible:
Assistance with degree recognition process
Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment
Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland
Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members)
Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.

Language training and relocation schedule:
Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential.
Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.

Salary and benefits:
Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience
ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting)
Comprehensive private occupational health care
Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers
Holiday bonus pay

Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process:
Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc
Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY
Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4

We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!

Please note:
(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.
(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

jobs.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

Car Finance at Marshmallow

Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time.

Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand.

Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders.

The Role

We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant.

This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine.

You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers.

  • Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin.

  • Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them.

  • Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning.

  • Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations.

  • Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster.

What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring.

  • Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning.

  • SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets.

  • A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't.

  • Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection.

Nice to have

  • Motor finance or other secured lending experience.

  • Experience of working within a rapidly scaling lending environment.

  • Familiarity with UK consumer credit regulation and how it shapes model design and use.

  • Experience using LLMs to speed up analytical work.

  • You already know some of the tooling Marshmallow uses: Snowflake, Python, Claude, Linear, Notion

Perks of the job

    • Culture interview (60 mins)

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data-intensive systems.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve.

What you'll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of significant projects within our database and processing systems, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • Deep fluency in at least one high-level language (we use Python and TypeScript, but we care more about depth than the specific language)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring

jobs.title: Senior IC PDK Development Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location (Islington)


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment, or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work.
 
Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.

We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer AI & Automation (d/m/w)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst produktive Softwarelösungen, die Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren, Daten nutzbar machen und Mitarbeitende im Alltag unterstützen. Dabei kombinierst Du fundiertes Software Engineering mit modernen KI-Technologien, um skalierbare Anwendungen mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Fachbereiche zu entwickeln:

  • Entwicklung produktionsreifer Software-, AI- und Automatisierungslösungen – von der Idee bis zum Go-Live
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung intelligenter Anwendungen, AI-Agenten und Assistenzsysteme auf Basis moderner LLM-Technologien
  • Entwicklung robuster Backend-Services, APIs und Frontends zur Integration interner und externer Systeme
  • Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung sinnvoller Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen
Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht an isolierten Proof-of-Concepts oder reinen Experimenten, sondern an produktiven Anwendungen, die täglich von Mitarbeitenden genutzt werden und einen direkten Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg leisten. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf professioneller Softwareentwicklung. KI-Technologien sind dabei ein Werkzeug, um innovative und skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Typescript sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme und Datenquellen
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Technologien wie OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Frameworks
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von RAG-Systemen, Embeddings, Vektor-Datenbanken und semantischer Suche
  • Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, Testing sowie im Einsatz von Docker und Cloud-Technologien
    Erfahrung im Aufbau produktiver Softwarelösungen über Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts hinaus
  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen
  • Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
Das wäre ein Plus 
  • Erfahrung mit Machine Learning über die Nutzung von LLMs hinaus (z. B. Modelltraining, Klassifikation oder Forecasting)
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot Studio oder der Power Platform
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM-, PIM- oder E-Commerce-Systemen (insbesondere SAP)
  • Erfahrung mit Process Automation und Workflow-Orchestrierung
Das zeichnet dich aus 
  • Du entwickelst gerne Lösungen, die produktiv eingesetzt werden und echten Mehrwert schaffen
  • Du möchtest nicht nur AI-Tools nutzen, sondern intelligente Systeme entwickeln und weiterdenken
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und Digitalisierung
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und bringst eigene Ideen ein


Das erwartet dich

  • Die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz von KI bei einem internationalen Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Spannende Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Unternehmensprozesse und Entscheidungen
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein motiviertes und erfolgreiches Team, das offen zusammenarbeitet und Wissen teilt
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem modernen und multikulturellen Umfeld
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine Unternehmenskultur, die Eigeninitiative fördert
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Hybrid- und Remote-Möglichkeiten
  • Exklusive Vorteile wie Hansefit, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Getränkeversorgung, frisches Obst und Essenszuschuss


Wann es für dich los geht

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. 

Wenn Du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, nachhaltige Software entwickeln möchtest und AI für Dich ein Werkzeug zur Lösung echter Probleme ist, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. 

Bitte sende uns Deinen Lebenslauf sowie Links zu GitHub-Projekten, technischen Referenzen oder eigenen Softwareprojekten. Wir möchten sehen, was Du bereits entwickelt hast und wie Du technische Herausforderungen löst.

One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

Role context

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

  • Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

  • Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.

jobs.title: Backend & Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data.

📝 Your Role

In a nutshell

You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability.

You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory.

Your impact

  • Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months.

  • Reduce production blind spots by improving incident detection and follow-through.

  • Evolve the architecture to better support concurrency, parallelism and processing volumes.

  • Help the team deliver AI components that are reliable, performant and properly integrated into the product.

Your day-to-day work

  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs in Python.

  • Work with the rest of the team, to deliver product changes end to end.

  • Measure and improve processing time, scalability and backend architecture.

  • Strengthen testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

  • Collaborate with, the Applied AI Engineer, particularly on pull-request reviews and the backend integration of AI-enabled features.

✨ Your Team

You will work closely with:

  • Ivan Panico — Lead ML Engineer and your manager, who will support your ramp-up and major architectural decisions.

  • Tom — Applied AI Engineer, who owns the main Applied AI topics and partners with you on product integration.

  • Armand — Full Stack Developer, your main partner for designing and delivering product features end to end.

The team is mainly based in Paris and works remotely from France.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Develop backend services in Python.

  • Design and evolve APIs.

  • Work with databases and data-processing workflows.

  • Use Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Understand latency, throughput, concurrency, parallelism and resource-consumption challenges.

  • Integrate an AI model or LLM API into a product, even through an initial hands-on experience.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • Open and direct communication.

  • An analytical mindset and the habit of testing your assumptions.

  • A collaborative approach across backend, frontend, product and applied AI.

  • The drive to learn quickly while asking for support at the right time.

  • Care for code quality and the operational consequences of technical choices.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Built up to two years of professional experience, through employment or significant projects in Python backend development.

  • Developed and deployed at least one service or API.

  • Used a database in a real application.

  • Worked with Docker and a continuous-integration workflow.

  • Worked in both French and English, with a minimum B2 level in each language.

It is a plus if you have worked on processing-intensive systems, NLP/LLM pipelines, healthcare data or a production SaaS product.

💛 Why join us?

  • Build a product that puts data and AI at the service of care and clinical research.

  • Progressively take real backend ownership with support suited to an early-career role.

  • Work on concrete performance, architecture and production-reliability challenges.

  • Collaborate daily with frontend and Applied AI engineers.

  • Join a team that works remotely from France while maintaining regular links with Paris.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Screening with Elena — 15 minutes. Motivation, role alignment, prerequisites and a brief English check.

  2. Manager fit with Ivan — 30 minutes. Role alignment, prerequisites.

  3. Technical interview with Ivan and Tom — 90 minutes for the candidate. You will have 30 minutes to work independently on a technical problem, followed by a 60-minute discussion of your approach, choices and trade-offs.

  4. Product collaboration interview with Jullian & Adil — 30 minutes

  5. Culture fit with Elena — 30 minutes.

They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.

Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.

Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions.

Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire !

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production.

Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements.

Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à :

🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques

  • Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients.

  • Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7).

  • Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité.

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production.

📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout

  • Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé.

  • Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement.

  • Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets.

jobs.title: First RevOps
jobs.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end

  • Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

  • Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

  • Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

  • Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense

  • Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

  • Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

  • Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

  • Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable

  • Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

  • Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

  • Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double

  • Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

  • Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win

  • You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

  • A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

  • Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure

  • Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

  • Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption

  • Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

  • Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

  • Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works

  • The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

  • The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable

  • You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential

  • 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

  • Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

  • At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

  • Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

  • You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have

  • A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values

  • Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

  • High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

  • Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

  1. First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

  2. Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

  3. Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

  4. Founder interview with Paul

  5. Reference checks, with your consent

  6. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

  • A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

  • The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

  • An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

  • Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

  • Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

  • Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

  • Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Procurement Manager, you will lead procurement, material planning and supply readiness to support our production schedules as we scale. You will own the operating mechanisms that turn demand into executable material plans, including Clear to Build (CTB) analysis, MRP execution and purchase order management. Leading a team of Buyers and Material Planners, you will work closely with Strategic Sourcing, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance and our suppliers to remove material constraints before they impact manufacturing.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop a team of Buyers and Material Planners, setting priorities and giving them the tools and training to execute.

  • Own Clear to Build analysis and translate demand into executable material plans for production.

  • Identify material constraints before they impact production, and drive cross functional actions to resolution.

  • Improve the quality of MRP inputs, including lead times, safety stocks, order policies, MOQ and planning parameters.

  • Hold suppliers accountable for delivery performance, and drive recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

  • Represent material readiness in production, S&OP, shortage and operational review meetings.

  • Monitor and report key indicators on supplier performance, material availability and supply risks.

  • Resolve downstream issues with receiving, finance and accounting teams.

  • Maintain procurement master data in the ERP system and build scalable processes as the company grows.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or a related discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of supply chain experience in progressive roles, ideally in a manufacturing environment.

  • Proven Leadership: 2+ years managing or leading procurement, planning or materials teams.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong practical knowledge of MRP logic, BOM driven material planning, inventory management and production supply.

  • Material Readiness: Demonstrated experience developing or operating Clear to Build processes in a manufacturing environment.

  • Scaling Experience: Experience supporting NPI, engineering changes and production ramps, and building scalable processes in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment and embraces a “no task is too small” mentality.

  • Communication & Influence: Fluency in French and English, with strong cross functional communication and the ability to drive action without relying solely on direct authority, from suppliers to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Strong plus / nice-to-have

  • Experience with React and TypeScript, particularly for custom user experiences or Power Apps Component Framework components.
  • Experience designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining custom software beyond Dynamics 365 and low-code solutions.
  • Experience with Azure integration services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
  • Practical experience with Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights – Journeys).

  • Experience with Power Platform governance or enterprise-scale environment and solution management.
  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio or AI-enabled capabilities within Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), or comparable Microsoft Learn training supported by relevant practical experience.
Working style and profile
  • Combines deep Dynamics 365 and Power Platform expertise with pragmatic software engineering judgment.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?
