jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

Your mission

This is not a classic legal role, and not a classic sales or product role. You operate at the intersection of Law, Revenue, and AI, where you are a lever, not a bottleneck: your job is to build the demos, playbooks, and standards that let the whole company scale, and to step into the calls where your expertise closes the gap.

We are honest: people who combine all of this are rare. We hire for aptitude and attitude, assess hands-on in a case study, and train the rest side by side, in real customer work.

1. You can sell the product (key). Not in the cold-calling sense, but in the way a great expert sells: by making the customer succeed in front of their own team. Concretely, this means you can (or want to learn to):

  • Run a live demo with confidence including customized, high-stakes demos and recover gracefully when something doesn't land: pull out a better prompt, adjust on the spot, turn a skeptical question into a stronger result.

  • Always leave with a next step. Trial licenses, a hackathon, a follow-up workshop, a scoped rollout conversation. You instinctively convert interest into momentum, and you remove friction ("we can make that happen") rather than adding process. Ideally you can point to moments where you influenced a deal, a renewal, or an expansion in any prior role.

2. Legal foundation. Solid legal training and hands-on experience with commercial contracts from in-house, law firm, or legal tech. You understand the "why" behind a clause and can teach that logic to an AI and to a customer. A German 2. Staatsexamen is welcome but not required: we explicitly encourage candidates with qualifications from other jurisdictions or non-traditional paths (e.g. law + IT).

3. Hands-on AI builder. You have spent serious time with LLMs, not as a spectator, but pushing them to their limits. You see prompting and evaluation as a craft and enjoy figuring out where AI systems break and how to fix them.

4. Ownership & communication. You can point to things you built, launched, or drove. You are structured enough to run projects with multiple stakeholders, and precise enough to know that a sharp prompt beats a thousand vague instructions. Excellent German and English; other languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, revenue, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • Leverage, not grind. You build the standards, playbooks, and demos that multiply your expertise across the whole company.

jobs.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

jobs.description:
O empregado de mesa é o profissional responsável por assegurar todo o serviço de refeições e bebidas num estabelecimento de restauração. As suas funções começam antes da chegada dos clientes, com a preparação da sala e a realização da mise-en-place, o que inclui a limpeza, arrumação e montagem correta das mesas com toalhas, talheres, copos e pratos.
Durante o serviço, este profissional executa o acolhimento e encaminhamento dos clientes, apresentando a ementa e a carta de vinhos. Cabe-lhe aconselhar os clientes, fazer sugestões gastronómicas e registar os pedidos, transmitindo-os de forma clara à cozinha e ao bar. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack JavaScript Developer – Sports Betting (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description:
We are partnering with a fast-growing international technology company within the sports betting and iGaming industry to recruit a Senior Full-Stack JavaScript Developer for their team in Sofia, Bulgaria.

This is an opportunity to work on high-performance, real-time betting products used in a fast-paced environment where scalability, reliability, and user experience are critical. You will take ownership across the full development lifecycle, working with modern JavaScript technologies to build and continuously improve complex sports betting platforms.

Your Role

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack JavaScript applications
- Build responsive and high-performance user interfaces using modern frontend technologies
- Develop robust backend services, APIs, and integrations supporting real-time sports betting products
- Work with high-volume, real-time data and ensure applications remain reliable during peak sporting events
- Design and integrate RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and third-party services
- Contribute to architectural decisions and help define technical standards and best practices
- Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and reusable code
- Identify performance bottlenecks and optimise applications for speed, scalability, and reliability
- Collaborate closely with Product, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams
- Participate in code reviews and support the continuous improvement of development processes
- Mentor less experienced developers and share technical knowledge across the engineering team
- Troubleshoot complex production issues and contribute to long-term technical solutions
- Stay up to date with emerging technologies and evaluate their potential application within the product

Your Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript
- Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or similar
- Strong backend development experience with Node.js
- Solid understanding of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with real-time technologies such as WebSockets
- Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Redis
- Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development
- Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern development workflows
- Familiarity with cloud environments and containerisation technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes is an advantage
- Strong understanding of application performance, security, and reliability
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges and work independently
- Strong English communication skills
- Previous experience within sports betting, iGaming, fintech, or another high-transaction digital environment is highly advantageous

The Offer

- Senior-level position within a growing international sports betting technology company
- Opportunity to work on complex, real-time and high-traffic products
- Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment
- High level of ownership and influence over technical decisions
- Opportunity to contribute to architecture, scalability, and product development
- Collaborative international engineering team
- Professional development and career growth opportunities
- Exposure to the latest technologies within the sports betting and iGaming industry
- Modern working environment in Sofia, Bulgaria
- Long-term opportunity within a fast-growing technology business

jobs.description:
Do you like working with people, take on responsibility and don't just want to work through tasks, but actively shape them?

For our team at the Olszyna site, we are looking for a committed personality who will actively accompany recruiting and employee support and develop it together with us.

**Your tasks**

•    Recruiting of employees, especially drivers, from the first contact to the successful start

•    Support of our employees and drivers in the ongoing employment relationship

•    Intensive support of new employees during the onboarding and hypercare phase

•    Active contact with employees, even in the event of absences and as part of the return to everyday work

•    Contact person for our German and Polish-speaking employees

•    Close cooperation and coordination with operations, scheduling and other internal interfaces

•    Maintenance and structured tracking of recruiting and employee data

•    Active participation in the further development of our recruiting and support processes

Your development perspective

With us, you will have the opportunity to develop professionally, take on responsibility and grow into a coordinating role in the future.

We are looking for people who are not just looking for a job, but who want to build something together with us.

•    Spoken and written German and Polish, other languages are a plus

•    Confident handling of MS Office, especially Excel, Outlook and Teams

•    Strong independence and initiative

•    Very good organization and structured way of working

•    Strong communication skills and enjoyment of dealing with different people

•    Decision-making skills and willingness to take responsibility

•    Hands-on mentality, flexibility and solution-oriented thinking

•    Energy, willingness to learn and desire to actively drive things forward

•    Mobility and reliable accessibility of our location in Olszyna

•    Class B driving licence is an advantage

**Your background**

Your professional or educational background is not decisive for us. Experience in recruiting, employee support, personnel services or logistics is an advantage, but not a must.

What counts most for us is your personality, motivation, way of working and your potential.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ODGOJITELJICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine broj10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) ) i članka 48. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Luščić i odluke Upravnog vijeća od 29.9.2026. godine, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Luščić raspisuje NATJEČAJ za popunu radnog mjesta odgojitelj/ica predškolske djece m/ž - 1 izvršitelja/ica za rad na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme Kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) i prema članku 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog obrazovanja (Narodne novine broj 145/2024):
  • završen preddiplomski sveučilišni studij ili preddiplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja, odnosno studij za odgojitelja kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima, ili završen diplomski sveučilišni studij ili specijalistički diplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja.
  • utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova (Vrtić će uputiti izabranog kandidata na utvrđivanje zdravstvene sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta).
Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Kandidati su obvezni dostaviti sljedeću dokumentaciju:
  • pisanu zamolbu, vlastoručno potpisanu, s navodom na koji natječaj se kandidat javlja,
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu ,
  • dokaz o radnom stažu: elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a (e-radna knjižica- ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  • dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne starije od dana objave natječaja):
a) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (čl. 25.st.2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), i, b) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (čl. 25.st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju). Dokumentacija se predaje u neovjerenom presliku. Potvrdu da osoba nije pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela (čl.25.st1. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) i/ili za neko od prekršajnih djela (čl.25.st.3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Ministarstva pravosuđa, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Potvrdu da osobi nisu izrečene mjere za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta sukladno posebnom propisu (čl.25.st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Centra za socijalnu skrb, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju odnosno sve dokaze o ostvarenju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, rješenje ili potvrda o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, potvrde o nezaposlenosti Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje izdanu u vrijeme trajanja natječaja te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca (rješenje, odluka, obavijest i sl.). Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario prednost pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj dostaviti dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavak 1.-2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) koji u trenutku prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatra se javna isprava na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić Luščić može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine 42/18). Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Zamolbu za prijem u radni odnos s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostaviti u roku osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno do 19.10.2026. godine. Zamolbu s dokazima je moguće dostaviti u zatvorenoj omotnici isključivo preporučenom poštom na adresu Dječji vrtić Luščić, Karlovac, Luščić 25 s naznakom: ˝Za natječaj za izbor odgojitelja – neodređeno vrijeme ( novootvorena radna mjesta) – ne otvarati ˝. Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. Obavijest o rezultatima natječaja objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici vrtića www.vrtic-luscic.hr s navodom imena i prezimena izabranih kandidata. Dječji vrtić Luščić zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Dječji vrtić Luščić Upravno vijeće Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Luščić dana 12.10.2026. godine.

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08., 86/09., 92/10., 105/10.-ispr, 90/11.,5/12., 16/12., 86/12., 94/13., 136/14.-RUSRH, 152/14., 7/17. i 68/18., 98/19., 64/20.,151/22, 156/23) članka 13. Pravilnika o radu te članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje ( u daljnjem tekstu : Pravilnik ) OŠ Vladimira Nazora, ravnateljica OŠ Vladimira Nazora, Postira, Polježice 12, objavljuje:

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

  1. Za radno mjesto stručnog suradnika, edukacijskog rehabilitatora

1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno, nepuno radno vrijeme, 20 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine 82/08. i 69/17.)

Uvjeti:

uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, kandidati moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Uvjete prema čl.29.(pod C) Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine broj 6/19, 75/20).

Radni odnos u školi ne može zasnovati osoba za koju postoje zapreke iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podatci (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela) adresa odnosno e-mail adresa na koju će se dostaviti obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja i naziv radnog mjesta na koji se prijavljuje.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:

  1. životopis
  2. diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  3. dokaz o državljanstvu
  4. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja
  5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ili

Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici.

Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani/a kandidat/kinja dužan/na je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika sukladno Zakonu o javnom bilježništvu (Narodne novine broj 78/93., 29/94., 162/98., 16/07., 75/09., 120/16.,i 57/22 )

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja je vlastoručno potpisana i sadrži u privitku priloge navedene u natječaju.

Kandidati/kandidatkinje koji su pravodobno podnijeli vlastoručnu potpisanu prijavu te ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni su postupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje u Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Nazora ( nalazi se na Web stranici škole ( http://os-vnazora-postira.skole.hr/upload/os-vnazora-postira/images/static3/709/attachment/Pravilnik_o_postupku_zaposljvanja_te_procjeni_vrednovanja_kandidata.pdf ) ukoliko se prema odluci Povjerenstva isto bude provodilo.

Način procjene odnosno testiranje kandidata ukoliko se isto bude provodilo, objavit će se na mrežnim stranicama škole. Poziv na pristupanje procjeni odnosno testiranju, putem elektroničke pošte dostavlja se najkasnije pet dana prije dana testiranja/ procjene onim kandidatima/kandidatkinjama koji su pravodobno podnijeli potpunu vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu te ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, odnosno Zakonske uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa i objavljuje se na mrežnim stranicama škole. Ukoliko kadidat/kandidatkinja ne pristupi procjeni odnosno testiranju smatra se da je odustao/la od prijave za natječaj.

Kandidat/kinja prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam dana od dana objave natječaja.

Prijave na natječaj dostavljaju se neposredno u zatvorenoj omotnici ili poštom na adresu OŠ Vladimira Nazora, Postira, Polježice 12 s naznakom „za natječaj“.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidat/kinja prijavljen/na na natječaj bit će obaviješten/na putem mrežne stranice školske ustanove (http://os-vnazora-postira.skole.hr/ )

najkasnije u roku od petnaest dana od dana sklapanja ugovora o radu s odabranim/om kandidatom/kinjom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, svi će kandidati biti obaviješteni i prema članku 21. stavku 4.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/CA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU
jobs.description:
POMOĆNIK/CA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme do 15.07.2027. godine

N A T J E Č A J

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na određeno vrijeme ½ radnog vremena

I. Raspisuje se natječaj za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u Dječjem vrtiću Runović (u nastavku teksta: Dječji vrtić) na radno mjesto POMOĆNIKA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU, na određeno vrijeme do 15.07.2027. godine na ½ radnog vremena 1 izvršitelj (M/Ž).

Uvjeti: SSS u trajanju od četiri godine.

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete propisane općim propisima o radu:

1. Punoljetnost

2. Hrvatsko državljanstvo

3. Radni iskustvo u trajanju od 6 mjeseci na poslovima pomoćnik/ce za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju

4. Potvrda o završenoj djelomičnoj edukaciji – pomoćnik/ca za rad s djecom s teškoćama u predškolskom sustavu

5. Zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta pomoćnika za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju.

6. Da nije roditelj ili drugi član uže obitelji djeteta kojem se pruža potpora.

Radni odnos u Dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona.

II. Prijavi na natječaj (u nastavku teksta: prijava) obvezno se prilažu sljedeći dokumenti:

  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice, važeće osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili vojne
  • iskaznice, sukladno članku 29. stavku 1. Zakona o hrvatskom državljanstvu (Narodne novine,broj: 53/91., 70/91., 28/92., 113/93., 130/11. i 110/15.)
  • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja
  • elektronički zapis odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje
  • Potvrda o završenoj djelomičnoj edukaciji – pomoćnik/ca za rad s djecom s teškoćama u predškolskom sustavu
  • kao dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakon predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju dostavljaju se sljedeći dokumenti (ne stariji od tri mjeseca računajući od dana objave natječaja na Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje):
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak prema članku 25. stavku 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema članku 25. stavku 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju potvrda nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta iz članka 25. stavka 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Prijavu i životopis potrebno je vlastoručno potpisati.

U prijavi se navode osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, OIB, datum i mjesto rođenja, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti dostavlja izabrani kandidat prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa, tj. potpisivanja ugovora o radu.

Dokumenti se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, a izabrani kandidat dužan je prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumentacije priložene uz prijavu.

Dopunu prijave moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka.

Ispunjavanje uvjeta određuje se na posljednji dan natječajnog roka.

III. Na natječaju ravnopravno mogu sudjelovati kandidati oba spola sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine, broj: 82/08. i 69/17.), a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe.

IV. Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat može ostvariti pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj: 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj: 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata), članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj: 84/21.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj: 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakon o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji) i članku 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina (Narodne novine, broj: 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) (u nastavku teksta: Ustavni zakon) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je dostaviti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima, dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava %20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti u skladu člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, i sve potrebne dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta odredbe na koju se poziva, odnosno dokaz o priznatom statusu, dokaz da to pravo već nije koristio te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka, sporazum i slično), a pravo prednosti ostvaruje samo pod uvjetom da nema osoba koje to pravo ostvaruju u skladu s odredbama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju- %20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o prestanku radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.).

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 22. Ustavnog zakona uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine

V. U skladu s uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, broj: 42/18.), prijavom na ovaj natječaj podnositelj prijave daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, u svrhu provedbe ovog natječaja.

VI. Prijava s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnosi se u roku osam dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i to isključivo preporučeno poštom, na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Runović, Runović 211, 21261 Runović, s naznakom. „Za natječaj – pomoćnik za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju“.

VII. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

VIII. Osobe koje podnesu nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave na natječaj ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj.

IX. Dječji vrtić zadržava pravo da po raspisanom natječaju ne mora izvršiti izbor, te se u tom slučaju donosi odluka o poništenju natječaja bez mogućnosti ulaganja pravnog lijeka.

X. O rezultatima natječaja, kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku.

XI. Ovaj će se natječaj objaviti na oglasnoj ploči i mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića.

RAVNATELJICA DJEČJEG VRTIĆA RUNOVIĆ

Marija Repušić

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICE GLAZBENE KULTURE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (" Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.), ravnateljica Osnovne škole Koprivnički Ivanec, Kunovec, Seljačke bune 10, 48 000 Koprivnica, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunu radnog mjesta 1. učitelj/ica glazbene kulture - 1 izvršitelj/ica s nepunim radnim vremenom od 20 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena (8 do 10 sati redovite nastave tjedno), na neodređeno vrijeme, mjesto rada Kunovec/Koprivnički Ivanec. UVJETI:
  • nepostojanje zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.),
  • prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.),
  • prema Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 6/19, 75/20.).
Uz prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • dokaz nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja),

Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili ovjerenoj preslici. Sukladno članku 13. stavku 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“ broj 82/08. i 69/17.) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose jednako na muške i ženske osobe. Kandidati koji će se u prijavi pozivati na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23.), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21.), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20.) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijave na javni natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostavljaju se poštom ili osobno u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno zaključno do 20.10.2026. godine, s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – UČITELJ/ICA GLAZBENE KULTURE“ na adresu: OSNOVNA ŠKOLA KOPRIVNIČKI IVANEC, KUNOVEC, SELJAČKE BUNE 10, 48 000 KOPRIVNICA Nepotpune i nepravodobno dostavljene prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidatom se smatra samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ovaj Javni natječaj objavit će se na oglasnim pločama i mrežnim stranicama Škole i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će, po završetku natječajnog postupka, biti obaviješteni na temelju obavijesti na mrežnim stranicama Škole (www.os-koprivnicki-ivanec.skole.hr). Za kandidate je obvezno usmeno vrednovanje koje priprema i provodi Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata na temelju Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Koprivnički Ivanec. Područje provjere, pravni i drugi izvori za pripremu kandidata za usmeno vrednovanje, vrijeme i mjesto održavanja usmenog vrednovanja bit će objavljeno na web stranici Škole: www.os-koprivnicki-ivanec.skole.hr Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Osnovnoj školi Koprivnički Ivanec za prikupljanje, korištenje i obradu svih dostavljenih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka (Opća uredbe (EU) 2016/679) o zaštiti osobnih podatka i Zakon o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.).

  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja
  • izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreke iz članka 39. stavka 2. Zakona o ustanovama („Narodne novine“ broj: 76/93, 29/97, 47/99, 35/08, 127/19, 151/22), vlastoručno potpisana

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102., stavak 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaze utvrđene u članku 49. stavku 1. navedenog Zakona: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-4413/4413 https://www.zakon.hr/z/2851/zakon-o-civilnim-stradalnicima-iz-domovinskog-rata https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj: 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, dužan je priložiti i rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo takvo pravo. Kandidat koji se u prijavi poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave na natječaj neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalno - pravne uvjete iz natječaja, a podnijeli su pravovremene i potpune prijave, bit će pozvani na usmeni razgovor. O vremenu usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem elektronske pošte nakon isteka roka za dostavljanje dokumentacije. Kandidati koji ne pristupe usmenom razgovoru smatra se da su povukli prijavu i više se ne smatraju kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj. Ravnatelja (m/ž) imenuje Upravno vijeće Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje, uz prethodnu suglasnost ministra Ministarstva rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike. Osoba imenovana za ravnatelja (m/ž) sklapa s Centrom za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje ugovor o radu u punom radnom vremenu na četiri godine. Ista osoba može biti ponovno imenovana za ravnatelja (m/ž). Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu Centru za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi povodom ovoga natječaja te dokumentaciji dostavljenoj s prijavom, u svrhu odabira kandidata te privolu za objavu informacije o izabranoj i imenovanoj osobi koja se objavljuje na internetskoj stranici Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje (www.centar-svitanje.hr), a koja uključuje ime i prezime odabranog kandidata te struku. Privola za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka je uvjet za prijavu na ovaj natječaj. Kandidat može u svakom trenutku bez objašnjenja odustati od dane privole i zatražiti prestanak aktivnosti obrade svojih osobnih podataka, o čemu će mu se izdati potvrda. Prijave na natječaj podnose se poštom (preporučenom pošiljkom) u roku od 8 dana od objave javnog natječaja u Narodnim novinama, na adresu: Centar za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje, Trg Tomislava dr. Bardeka 10/10 III. kat, Koprivnica, s naznakom: »Natječaj za ravnatelja (m/ž) – ne otvarati«. O rezultatu natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku sukladno članku 41. stavku 3. Zakona o ustanovama.

jobs.title: Value Strategist
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

  • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

  • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

  • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

  • Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points

  • Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

  • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

  • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

  • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Matematiklærer til Lørslev Friskole
jobs.description:
Har du hjerte for matematik, børn og fællesskab? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en dygtig matematiklærer, der møder både små og store elever med varme, tydelighed og troen på, at alle kan udvikle sig – uanset udgangspunkt.

Vi forestiller os, at du er læreruddannet med linjefag i matematik eller har tilsvarende faglige og didaktiske kompetencer. Du brænder for at gøre matematikken forståelig og spændende, og du formår at støtte og udfordre eleverne på deres forskellige faglige niveauer. En del af undervisningen foregår med to lærere i klassen, så fælles forberedelse, samarbejde og faglig sparring er en naturlig del af jobbet.

Stillingen indeholder også timer i vores SFO, så kan du bidrage med et praktisk-musisk fag, en interesse for udeliv eller lignende er det helt klart en fordel.

Du skal være en hjertevarm og tydelig rollemodel, som har nemt ved at danne positive relationer med både børn, forældre og kolleger.

Du skal kunne trives i en lille personalegruppe med humor og en uformel tone.

Du skal være mødestabil og hjælpsom, vi løfter nemlig i flok. 

Lørslev Friskole er en lille og veletableret skole med fine faciliteter både inde og ude. Vi har 88 elever fra 0.-9. klasse, som er fordelt på mindre sammenlæste hold.

Vi gør os umage med at skabe en herlig skolehverdag, hvor trivsel og faglighed går hånd i hånd. 

Naturen omkring skolen bruger vi aktivt i undervisningen. Vi tager gerne på tur – og det er tit på cykel, så det er et must, at du kan tænke “på cykel ud af huset” ind i din undervisning.

Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling, så du skal være omstillingsparat og hoppe med på sjove tiltag, hvor der skal tænkes kreativt, praktisk og anderledes. 

Stillingen er en fastansættelse på 75 % -gerne med opstart d. 1. november eller snarest derefter. 

Du skal kigge vores vej, hvis du helhjertet kan se dig selv være en del af en lille friskole og har lyst til at give noget af dig selv! 

Vil du vide mere om os, kan du tjekke vores Facebookside, besøge vores hjemmeside på www.loerslevfriskole.dk eller kontakte skoleleder Anne Alon på tlf. 40 55 79 44.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst mellem LC og Finansministeriet.

Forud for ansættelse indhentes børneattest. 

Ansøgningsfrist: fredag d. 23. oktober 2026 – vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 44

Ansøgning, CV samt relevante bilag fremsendes elektronisk til job@loerslevfriskole.dk

Såfremt du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Technical Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

  • Bring the market back to the product: what enterprises ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins one.

  • Stand up the GTM stack — CRM discipline, sequences, forecasting — so the next hires inherit a system, not a mess.

  • Represent Hodor in the field: meetups, conferences, CISO and platform-leader circles.

  • Hire and ramp the first AEs and SDRs once the motion is repeatable.

What you bring

  • Real closing experience in B2B SaaS — you've carried a quota and beaten it, and you can walk through the deals.

Nice to have

  • You've sold cybersecurity, developer tools, or data infrastructure.

  • You were among the first ten at a startup and watched a GTM motion go from zero to repeatable.

  • You think cold calling is beneath you.

  • You'd rather manage a team than close deals yourself for the first year.

  • You don't thrive at the fast pace of early-stage startups.

  • You're not joining a sales org, you're founding one — and the playbook has your name on it.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with the founders, with a direct line to the roadmap you're selling.
