jobs.description:
About the role

As an Hybrid Cloud Computing Architect specializing in cloud and database technologies, you will play a key role in transforming on-premises databases towards public cloud and autonomous database services, designing scalable, secure, and cost-conscious solutions.

You are offered
A permanent, full-time position within a forward-thinking global IT organization, offering hybrid remote work options, professional growth in cutting-edge cloud technologies, and a collaborative team environment.

Work tasks

In this role, you will lead the database modernization journey, collaborating with global teams and suppliers to architect secure, scalable cloud-native database solutions.
- Take architectural responsibility for cloud and database solutions, including security, performance, and integrations
- Support the transformation of on-premises database environments towards public cloud and autonomous database services
- Develop and design new database and cloud-based data platform services, improving usability and maintainability
- Contribute to cloud migration planning, database modernization, and architecture reviews with application teams
- Collaborate with the Chief Architect to support roadmap development and long-term technology direction
- Align business roadmaps with database and cloud technology roadmaps, considering capacity, security, and cost
- Support external BUILD development and ensure smooth, well-documented handovers to RUN operations

We are looking for

- Strong understanding of database technologies, such as Oracle and SQL Server
- Good knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, public cloud services, and migration approaches
- Experience or strong interest in autonomous database services and managed database platforms
- Basic knowledge of project management and agile methodologies
- Experience in supplier management and collaborating with technology vendors and application teams

It is meritorious if you have
- Understanding of performance optimization, security compliance, and lifecycle management
- Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectural roadmaps
- Excellent communication and coordination skills in a global environment

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work. We will tell more about our client company in the interview stages.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Fencing Operative
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking reliable and hardworking Fencing Operatives to join our fencing team. The successful candidates will work as part of a 2–3 person fencing crew, carrying out a wide range of fencing projects throughout County Kerry. The role will suit someone with previous fencing experience, but candidates with a strong construction, agricultural or practical background will also be considered. Full training can be provided. We are looking for people who are physically fit, practical and willing to work outdoors in a demanding environment. Previous fencing experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to learn are equally important. Key Responsibilities The fencing operative will be involved in a wide range of fencing and associated work, including: Agricultural stock fencing. Electric fencing. Post-and-rail fencing. Timber fencing. Deer fencing. Mesh and wire fencing. Installation of gates and gate systems. Fence repairs and maintenance. Setting out fence lines. Digging and installing fence posts. Installing concrete and timber posts. Straining and tensioning wire. Fixing mesh, wire and rails. Using hand and power tools. Removing existing fencing where required. Site preparation and clean-up where required by the particular job. Loading, unloading and handling fencing materials. Maintaining a clean and safe working area. Working safely and efficiently as part of a fencing crew. Following instructions provided by the office and supervisors. Working to the required standard and completing jobs efficiently. Working Environment The majority of the work is outdoors and can involve challenging ground conditions and changing weather. The role is physically demanding and requires the operative to spend most of the working day on their feet, carrying materials, digging, installing posts and using hand and power tools. The successful candidate must be comfortable working outdoors and carrying out physically demanding work on farms, construction sites, commercial properties, forestry areas and other locations. Working Hours Normal working hours are: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm The role is primarily Monday to Friday, with no regular weekend work expected. The company base is in Castleisland, County Kerry. Transport will be provided from the base to work sites as required. Tools & Equipment All necessary fencing tools and equipment will be provided by the company. The majority of the work will involve hand tools and standard fencing equipment, although there are opportunities for employees who wish to develop their skills in machinery operation. Experience operating equipment such as: Post drivers Mini diggers Tractors Augers Other construction or agricultural machinery would be an advantage but is not essential. Experience & Qualifications Previous professional fencing experience is preferred. However, candidates with experience in: Agricultural work General construction

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri, Vantaan Energia
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Energialle kahta kunnossapitoinsinööriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Olemme yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kaupunkienergiayhtiöistä ja Suomen suurin jätteen energiahyödyntäjä. Tuotamme ja toimitamme lämpöä ja sähköä sekä tarjoamme näihin liittyviä palveluita. Ratkaisemme asiakkaidemme haasteita varmistamalla, että energia kiertää mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta, jotta vantaalaisilla olisi tarjolla edullista, toimitusvarmaa ja yhä vähäpäästöisempää energiaa sekä siihen liittyviä palveluita nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Kunnianhimoisten suunnitelmiemme ydin on osaava, motivoitunutja hyvinvoiva henkilöstömme, josta huolehtiminen on meille ykkösasia. www.vantaanenergia.fi

Tehtävä

Tehtävät sijoittuvat korkealämpötilalaitokselle (HWP) ja jätevoimala 2-laitokselle. Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat oman laitoksesi kunnossapitotoiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja toimintavarmuudesta. Kyseessä on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen asiantuntija-sekä esihenkilörooli, jossa toimit oman laitoksen kunnossapidon vetäjänä. Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa laitoksen turvallinen, tehokas ja häiriötön toiminta sekä tuotanto-omaisuuden pitkäjänteinen kehittäminen.

Tehtävässä toimit kunnossapidon tiimin esihenkilönä sekä vastaat ulkoistenpalveluntarjoajien ja alihankkijoiden ohjauksesta. Osallistut myös kunnossapidon budjetointiin, investointien suunnitteluun sekä kehityshankkeisiin yhteistyössä tuotannon, käytön ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- oman laitoksen kunnossapitotoiminnan sekä tiimin johtaminen ja kehittäminen
- tuotantolaitoksen käytettävyyden, turvallisuuden ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
- kunnossapidon pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelu ja kehitystyö
- kunnossapidon budjetointiin osallistuminen sekä kustannusten seuranta
- hankintojen, kilpailutusten ja ulkoisten palveluiden koordinointi
- kunnossapidon KPI-mittareiden ja tunnuslukujen seuranta sekä kehittäminen
- alihankkijoiden työn ohjaus ja valvonta
- yhteistyö tuotannon, käytön, omaisuudenhallinnan sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
- lakisääteisten velvollisuuksien ja turvallisuusvaatimusten noudattamisen varmistaminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa kokonaisvastuun oman energiantuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta osana vakavaraista ja tulevaisuuteen katsovaa energia-alan yritystä. Pääset työskentelemään keskeisessä roolissa, jossa vaikutat suoraan laitoksen suorituskykyyn, turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.

Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, osaavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi ja johtamisosaamistasi energia-alan mielenkiintoisimpien tehtävien parissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa esim. kone- tai energiatekniikka (insinööri tai DI)
- usean vuoden kokemusta kunnossapitotehtävistä prosessiteollisuudessa
- voimalaitos-, energia- tai kaukolämpötekniikan tuntemusta
- ymmärrystä kunnossapidon menetelmistä ja kehittämisestä
- hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaitoja ja valmiuksia toimia esihenkilötehtävistä
- kehitysmyönteistä, suunnitelmallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa
- hankinta- ja kilpailutusosaaminen katsotaan eduksi
- kiinteiden polttoaineiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja solmitaan suoraan Vantaan Energia Oy:n kanssa.Barona toimii rekrytointikumppanina.

Oletko sinä uusi energia-alan huipputekijä?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävät täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Tietosuojasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tai WhatsAppin kautta.

Tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, työhöntulotarkastusta sekä huumausainetestausta. Nämä toteutetaan valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Katri Hyppänen, Seniorikonsultti, Barona Teknisetasiantuntijat p. 050 439 9785 ma-to klo 10-14.

jobs.title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

jobs.title: Vi søker utleieansvarlig til vår avdeling i Bergen
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge AS er en helhetsleverandør innen sikkerhet på arbeidsplassen, med spesialkompetanse på løsninger for trafikkerte miljøer. Vi leverer utstyr, tjenester og kunnskap som bidrar til å skape trygge arbeidsplasser hver eneste dag.  

Vi ser nå etter en engasjert og dyktig kollega til et ettårig vikariat ved vår avdeling i Bergen. Vi ønsker å få vår nye kollega på plass så snart som mulig, og for den rette kandidaten kan det også være muligheter videre etter endt vikariat.

Som utleieansvarlig får du en variert arbeidshverdag der kundekontakt, utleie og koordinering går hånd i hånd med praktiske oppgaver på lageret. Du blir en viktig del av den daglige driften, og vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar, holde oversikt og bidra til god flyt i en tidvis hektisk hverdag. Samtidig er du en lagspiller som samarbeider godt med de rundt deg og har sikkerhet og kvalitet i fokus.

 

Hva vil du jobbe med?  

De viktigste arbeidsoppgavene dine: 

  • Mottak, lasting og lossing av varer
  • Plukking, pakking og klargjøring av utstyr til prosjekter
  • Sørge for god orden og struktur på lageret
  • Ansvar for utleie, inkludert oppfølging av kunder, sjekklister og fakturering
  • Samhandle med kolleger, sjåfører og øvrige avdelinger
  • Daglig bruk av truck og hjullaster
  • Montering av varsling og sikringsutstyr ved arbeid på og langs vei

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar og har evne til å holde oversikt i en variert og tidvis hektisk arbeidshverdag. Du følger opp oppgaver, prioriterer når det er mye som skjer og trives med å koordinere arbeidet på lageret.

Hos oss er samarbeid en viktig del av hverdagen. Vi håper derfor du er en kollega som bidrar positivt, hjelper til der det trengs og er opptatt av å skape en god arbeidshverdag sammen med menneskene rundt deg.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Er selvgående og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i dialog med både kunder og kolleger
  • Har et tydelig fokus på sikkerhet i arbeidshverdagen

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Kompetansebevis M4 – Hjullaster
  • Gyldig truckførerbevis T1-T4
  • Bestå APV 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse)
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Er komfortabel med bruk av digitale verktøy i arbeidshverdagen

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring fra lignende rolle eller relevant bransje
  • Førerkort klasse BE og CE

 

Hvorfor velge oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger som samarbeider godt, deler kunnskap og har det hyggelig sammen på jobb. Du får en variert rolle med ansvar og mulighet til å bli en viktig del av den daglige driften ved avdelingen og bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid på og langs veiene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med hjelpsomme og trivelige kollegaer
  • En trygg arbeidsplass i et selskap som setter kvalitet og sikkerhet først

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 

Søknadsfrist: 30.10.26 – Vi vurderer søknader og tar kontakt med aktuelle kandidater fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et kristent friplejehjem, der føles som et HJEM? – Og samtidig være en del af et fællesskab, hvor faglighed, omsorg og værdier går hånd i hånd?

Løsning Friplejehjem åbnede i juni 2026 med 30 boliger. Vi er godt i gang med at skabe et hjem fyldt med liv, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi søger nu en engageret og omsorgsfuld social- og sundhedshjælper, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Stillingen er primært i dagvagt, men du skal være indstillet på, at der efter behov kan forekomme enkelte aftenvagter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at være med til at præge hverdagen, kulturen og fællesskabet på et nyt friplejehjem, hvor vi ønsker at gøre en positiv forskel for vores beboere – hver eneste dag.

Et hjem med mennesket i centrum

På Løsning Friplejehjem arbejder vi ud fra et kristent menneskesyn, hvor næstekærlighed, respekt, værdighed og omsorg er grundlæggende værdier.

Vi tror på, at et plejehjem først og fremmest skal være et HJEM. Et sted, hvor beboerne oplever tryghed, selvbestemmelse og livsglæde, og hvor der er plads til både fællesskab og individuelle ønsker og behov.

Vi ønsker at skabe en hverdag, hvor vi ikke blot løser plejeopgaver, men ser det hele menneske og har blik for de små øjeblikke, der gør livet værdifuldt.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper.

  • Brænder for at skabe en tryg, værdig og meningsfuld hverdag for ældre mennesker.

  • Møder beboere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt, varme og et positivt menneskesyn.

  • Er fagligt engageret, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Værdsætter et godt kollegialt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat – og trives med en hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs.

  • Har lyst til at tage medansvar for udviklingen af vores fælles praksis og kultur.

  • Kan se dig selv arbejde ud fra vores værdigrundlag og omsætte det til handling i hverdagen.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor værdierne ikke blot står på papir, men skal kunne mærkes i hverdagen.

  • En stilling primært i dagvagt med enkelte aftenvagter efter behov.

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange, kultur og udviklingen af vores friplejehjem.

  • Et engageret kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på høj faglighed, trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • En nærværende ledelse med fokus på dialog, tillid og frihed under ansvar.

  • En hverdag, hvor der er plads til humor, forskellighed og gode idéer.

  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i beboernes liv.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi søger en kollega, som har hjertet på rette sted, og som har lyst til at være med til at skabe et hjem, hvor både beboere, pårørende og medarbejdere føler sig velkomne, set og værdsat.

Vi tror på, at den bedste ældrepleje skabes i fællesskab – gennem faglighed, nærvær, engagement og respekt for det enkelte menneske.

Har du lyst til at være med? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er primært i dagvagt, men du skal være indstillet på, at der efter behov kan forekomme enkelte aftenvagter.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

jobs.title: Head of Crypto
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

  • Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

  • Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

  • Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

  • Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up.

  • Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework.

  • Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team.

  • Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

  • Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

jobs.title: Skønne Frederik i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Konserniimme kuuluvat SantaPark – Christmas Theme Park, Santa Claus Secret Forest – Joulukka, Arctic TreeHouse Hotel, Rakas Restaurant & Bar, Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, AINO Private Island sekä Lapland Luxury DMC.

Tavoitteenamme on luoda vieraillemme elinikäisiä muistoja. Haluamme tarjota myös henkilöstöllemme innostavan työympäristön, jossa on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa yhdessä jotakin ainutlaatuista.

Etsimme kokenutta ja kehittämishenkistä IT Manageria vastaamaan konsernimme IT-ympäristön toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät IT-kokonaisuuksien hallinta, kehitysprojektit ja käytännönläheinen ongelmanratkaisu. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä konsernin CTO, ulkoisen IT-palvelukumppanin ja liiketoimintayksiköidemme kanssa varmistaen, että teknologiset ratkaisumme tukevat sujuvaa arkea ja korkeatasoista asiakaskokemusta.

**Keskeiset vastuualueesi:**

- Konsernin IT-ympäristön, järjestelmien, laitteiden ja infrastruktuurin hallinta ja kehittäminen

- IT-strategian toteuttaminen, IT-budjetin seuranta ja kehityshankkeiden koordinointi

- Tietoturvan, tietosuojan ja järjestelmien toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen

- IT-palvelukumppaneiden, toimittajasuhteiden ja palvelutasojen hallinta

- Järjestelmäkäyttöönottojen, integraatioiden ja muiden IT-projektien johtaminen

- Henkilöstön IT-tuen sujuvuuden varmistaminen sekä vaativampien teknisten haasteiden ratkaiseminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä IT-alan ammattilaista, joka hallitsee laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja tarttuu tarvittaessa myös käytännön tekemiseen.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa IT-alan koulutusta tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- Vahvaa kokemusta IT-ympäristöjen hallinnasta ja kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisista IT-tehtävistä

- Hyvää osaamista verkoista, pilvipalveluista, tietoturvasta ja liiketoimintajärjestelmistä

- Kokemusta IT-projektien johtamisesta, toimittajayhteistyöstä ja kustannusten hallinnasta

- Itsenäistä ja kehittämisorientoitunutta työotetta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Arvostamme kokemusta matkailu-, majoitus- tai palvelualalta sekä ymmärrystä sesonkiluonteisen liiketoiminnan erityispiirteistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa matkailualan konsernissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa konsernin IT-ratkaisuihin ja kehittää toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti

- Itsenäisen roolin ja tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen, johdon ja IT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kasvaa ammatillisesti

- Innostavan ja yhteistyöhenkisen työyhteisön sekä SantaPark Arctic Worldin henkilöstöedut


Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Rovaniemellä. Työhön sisältyy liikkumista konsernin eri toimipisteiden välillä. Raportoit tehtävässä talousjohtajallemme.

jobs.title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Myyjä, S-market Kommila, Varkaus
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VARKAUS

S-MARKET KOMMILA etsii nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 15 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan marraskuussa

Marketpäällikkö Suvi kertoo työskentelystä Kommilassa näin: Meille asiakaskokemus, työyhteisön kanssa #yhdessä tekeminen ja myymälän kehittäminen ovat ykkösjuttuja. Meillä pääset tekemään laajasti erilaisia kaupan alan tehtäviä asiakaspalvelusta ja hyllytyksestä aina S-kaupat-tilausten tekemiseen.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä asiakaspalvelun, kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös S-kaupat-tilausten keräilyä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan tehtäviin. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä. Kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti ja palveluhenkisesti sekä haluat auttaa niin asiakkaita kuin työkavereitakin onnistumaan. Kaupan vaihtelevassa arjessa työ edellyttää kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja priorisoida tekemistä. Arvostamme reipasta ja huolellista työotetta, uteliasta asennetta sekä halua oppia jatkuvasti uutta. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja vuorot sijoittuvat noin klo 5-22 välille, joten työskentely eri vuoroissa onnistuu sinulta.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme aiempaa työkokemusta kaupan alalta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: tuntipalkka on kokemuksesta riippuen 11,16 €/t–14,93 €/t. Lisät maksetaan kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa, jos itse haluat.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.10.2026.

Lisätietoja: Marketpäällikkö Suvi Kuivisto, suvi.kuivisto@sok.fi, puh. 050 387 9482

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 136 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)
jobs.description:
Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)

About the Position

Mono Rakennus Oy is recruiting two experienced Site Managers for our data centre construction projects in Mäntsälä and Pori, Finland.

We are looking for professionals with strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in interior construction and fit-out works, particularly Sandwich elements, drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, structural ceilings (TATE-ceiling) and finishing works.

The successful candidates will be responsible for managing daily site operations, supervising construction teams, coordinating with the main contractor, and ensuring that all works are completed safely, efficiently, and according to project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and supervise daily interior construction and fit-out activities.

- Coordinate installation works, including drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, doors, and finishing works.

- Plan and allocate manpower, materials, tools, and equipment.

- Monitor construction progress and ensure compliance with project schedules.

- Supervise construction workers and subcontractors.

- Coordinate daily activities with the main contractor and other trades.

- Review construction drawings, technical specifications, and installation requirements.

- Conduct quality inspections and ensure compliance with project standards.

- Ensure compliance with site HSE requirements, RAMS, and safe working procedures.

- Prepare daily and weekly progress reports, including manpower allocation and completed quantities.

- Participate in site coordination and progress meetings.

- Identify potential delays and implement practical solutions.


Requirements

- **Currently residing in Finland.**

- **Valid right to work in Finland (work permit, where applicable).**

- **Minimum 3 years of construction site management experience in Finland.**

- Proven experience in interior construction and fit-out works.

- Strong knowledge of drywall systems, internal partitions, suspended ceilings, and finishing works.

- Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

- Experience managing construction teams and coordinating multiple activities.

- Good understanding of Finnish construction practices, quality standards, and occupational safety regulations.

- Strong organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for site operations.

- Good command of English.

- Valid Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti).

- Category B driving licence.


Considered an Advantage

- Previous experience in data centre construction projects.

- Experience working with international main contractors.

- Relevant qualification in construction engineering or construction management.

- Finnish language skills.


What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on large-scale data centre construction projects in Finland.

- A responsible and independent position within a growing construction company.

- Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

- Professional and international working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and continued employment on future projects.


How to Apply

Please send your CV in English and salary expectation, including a brief description of your previous construction site management experience in Finland, particularly in interior construction and fit-out projects, to the following email address.

Info@monorakennus Oy

Please do not apply if you are outside of Finland we are not supporting visa or residence permit.

Please indicate your preferred working location (Mäntsälä or Pori) in your application.

**Only candidates who meet the mandatory requirements will be considered.**

Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.

Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/547f419b-5389-4d1d-9b3c-4499da3384d1/original.png]

Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?
As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

Why join us?
At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

Are you interested?
Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 18.10.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period may close the job posting earlier if the positions are filled.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi]).

jobs.title: Myyntineuvottelija Huutokaupat.comille, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Etsimme Huutokaupat.comille aktiivista ja tavoitteellista myyntineuvottelijaa, joka innostuu asiakaskohtaamisista, neuvotteluista ja kauppojen kotiuttamisesta. Jos olet rohkea tarttumaan puhelimeen, nautit myyntityöstä ja haluat nähdä työsi tulokset konkreettisesti, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Työnkuva:

Huutokaupat.com on yksi Suomen tunnetuimmista verkkomarkkinapaikoista, jossa yli miljoona suomalaista vierailee kuukausittain tutustumassa monipuolisiin huutokauppakohteisiin. Myyntineuvottelijana pääset osaksi palvelun myyntitiimiä ja vaikutat suoraan siihen, kuinka moni huutokauppa johtaa onnistuneeseen kauppaan.

Tehtävässäsi käyt läpi päättyneitä huutokauppoja ja tunnistat tilanteita, joissa kauppa on vielä mahdollista saada syntymään. Otat yhteyttä huutajiin, käyt hintaneuvotteluja ja etsit ratkaisuja, joiden avulla sekä ostaja että myyjä pääsevät molempia tyydyttävään lopputulokseen.

Työhösi kuuluu myös tiivis yhteistyö myyjien ja muun myyntitiimin kanssa. Tavoitteenasi on edistää myyntimahdollisuuksia, saavuttaa asetetut tavoitteet ja varmistaa, että asiakkaat saavat hyvää palvelua koko prosessin ajan.

Toivomme sinulta:

Tavoitteellista, aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta.
Myyntihenkisyyttä ja hyviä neuvottelutaitoja.
Rohkeutta kontaktoida asiakkaita ja edistää kauppojen syntymistä.
Kykyä kuunnella asiakasta ja löytää molempia osapuolia hyödyttäviä ratkaisuja.
Asiakaslähtöistä asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.
Hyvää suomenkielen taitoa sekä riittävää englanninkielen osaamista asiakastilanteiden hoitamiseen tarvittaessa.

Aiempi kokemus HubSpotista tai muusta CRM-järjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi. Myös huutokauppaliiketoiminnan tuntemus ja muu kielitaito ovat plussaa, mutta aiempaa kokemusta huutokauppa-alalta ei vaadita.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi rentoa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen on tavoitteellista mutta ilmapiiri välitön. Työkavereilta saat tukea ja sparrausta, ja onnistumisia rakennetaan yhdessä. Tarjoamme sinulle nykyaikaiset työvälineet, toimivat työskentelytavat ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi osana tunnettua ja kasvavaa verkkomarkkinapaikkaa.

Työsuhde alkaa kuuden kuukauden määräaikaisella jaksolla Bolt.Worksin kautta. Hyvälle tekijälle voi avautua mahdollisuus jatkaa tämän jälkeen Huutokaupat.comin omilla kirjoilla.

Työsuhteen tiedot:

Aloitus: Mahdollisimman pian.
Työaika: 37,5 tuntia viikossa, maanantaista perjantaihin.
Työajat: Liukuva työaika klo 6–19 välillä.
Työntekopaikka: Toimisto sijaitsee Helsingin Ruoholahdessa, mutta työskentely onnistuu myös muualla Suomessa.
Palkkaus: Kiinteä kuukausipalkka noin 1800–2 400 euroa sekä provisio. Provisioiden määrä on arviolta 300–700 euroa kuukaudessa, joten kokonaisansioihin voi vaikuttaa omalla tekemisellään.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos nautit myyntityöstä, viihdyt neuvottelutilanteissa ja haluat olla mukana viemässä kauppoja maaliin, tämä voi olla sinulle sopiva mahdollisuus.

Verkkopalvelu: https://huutokaupat.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/huutokaupatcom
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/huutokaupatcom/
LinkedIn: https://fi.linkedin.com/company/huutokaupat.com

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

  • Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

  • Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

  • Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites.

Your Background

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project.

  • Strong coding skills in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2.

  • Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged.

  • Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo.

  • Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL).

What We Offer

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

RENTEQ Automotive søger efter to praktiske og dygtige mekanikere, der kan tage hånd om skrueopgaver i forbindelse med konvertering fra diesel til el på primært maskiner og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner samt at bygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker på vores udviklingsværksted arbejder du med den praktiske af- og remontage på maskiner og andre køretøjer. Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage efter foreløbige arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et delvist internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til bence@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Bence Pati Nagy på bence@ren-teq.com eller på 20778078
