Er du en stærk sælger, der motiveres af ansvar, kundekontakt og muligheden for at drive dine egne salgsforløb? Hos Rotpunkt Esbjerg får du mulighed for at kombinere salg, rådgivning og indretning og følge kunderne hele vejen fra de første idéer til det færdige køkken. Her bliver dit salgsdrive, dit initiativ og din evne til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser afgørende.

Rotpunkt 
Rotpunkt er et veletableret brand inden for køkken, bad og garderobe med fokus på kvalitet, funktionelt design og individuelle løsninger. Virksomheden hjælper kunder med at realisere deres boligdrømme gennem professionel rådgivning og skræddersyede løsninger, der matcher både behov og livsstil. 

Hos Rotpunkt Esbjerg bliver du en del af et mindre team med en uformel hverdag, korte beslutningsveje og stor frihed under ansvar. Her er der tæt samarbejde og plads til sparring, samtidig med at der er en forventning om, at du tager ansvar for dine egne opgaver og bidrager aktivt til butikkens hverdag.  

Skab unikke køkkenløsninger og stærke kunderelationer 
Som salgs- & indretningskonsulent får du ansvar for dine egne kunder og følger dem gennem hele processen, fra den første dialog og behovsafdækning til opmåling, indretning, tilbud, ordre og den videre opfølgning. 

Du rådgiver kunderne om blandt andet indretning, materialer, funktionalitet og løsninger og hjælper dem med bedst muligt at træffe de mange valg, der følger med et nyt køkken. Det kræver, at du er god til at skabe relationer og tillid og kan guide kunden trygt gennem hele processen. 

Du får en høj grad af selvstændighed, stor indflydelse på dine projekter og mulighed for at arbejde med attraktive løsninger i høj kvalitet. 

Stillingen har primært fokus på privatkunder, men du vil også få berøring med erhvervssalg, som Rotpunkt Esbjerg ønsker at udvikle yderligere over tid. 

Du er en stærk sælger med blik for den gode kundeoplevelse
For at få succes i rollen er det afgørende, at du har en naturlig forståelse for salg og kundekontakt og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater og stærke relationer. Du er god til at afdække kundernes behov, skabe tillid gennem hele salgsprocessen og omsætte deres ønsker til konkrete løsninger. Samtidig har du sans for indretning, materialer og funktionalitet. 

Som person arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du har et stort drive og tager naturligt ansvar i hverdagen. 

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med rådgivende salg, eksempelvis fra køkken-, møbel-, detail-, mode- eller boligbranchen. Erfaring fra køkkenbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du får en grundig introduktion til produkterne, arbejdsgangene og salgsprocessen. Der er god mulighed for sparring undervejs, og derfor behøver du ikke nødvendigvis komme fra køkkenbranchen. Har du en stærk salgsbaggrund og lyst til at lære faget, bliver du klædt godt på til opgaven.  

Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og arbejdsglæde vægtes højt.

jobs.title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
jobs.description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

Sinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Monipuolinen alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi sekä kaikenlainen koneasennuksen ja hydrauliikan tuntemus sekä autopuolen harrastuneisuus. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.

Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. Within the DKCCC project, the candidate will contribute to strengthening connections between the Danish ecosystem and EU pilot lines and to translating spintronic device research into fabrication, prototyping, and technology-development activities.

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Employment terms

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

jobs.title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
jobs.description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. 

 

Further information 

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Barselsvikariat – Administrativ indkøbskoordinator
jobs.description:
Fourcom ApS søger en struktureret og serviceminded kollega til et spændende barselsvikariat, hvor du får en central rolle i samspillet mellem indkøb, produktion og salg.

Har du sans for struktur, koordinering og god leverandørkontakt? Trives du med at have mange bolde i luften og samtidig sikre, at tingene bliver fulgt helt til dørs? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Som en del af Fourcom ApS bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift, hvor du er med til at sikre et effektivt flow fra indkøb til produktion og videre ud til vores kunder.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for blandt andet:

  • Koordinering mellem indkøb og produktion, så de rette varer og materialer er tilgængelige, når de skal bruges

  • Oprettelse og vedligeholdelse af indkøb, herunder sikring af korrekt information og opfølgning

  • Oprettelse og administration af varenumre, så vores produkt- og indkøbsdata altid er strukturerede og opdaterede

  • Dialog og koordinering med leverandører omkring ordrer, leverancer, priser og eventuelle udfordringer

  • Håndtering og koordinering af retursager, fra oprettelse til afslutning

  • Tæt kommunikation mellem salg og produktion, hvor du er med til at sikre, at information og aftaler bliver omsat til handling

  • Generelle indkøbs- og koordineringsopgaver, hvor du bidrager til at skabe struktur og fremdrift i hverdagen

En rolle med mange kontaktflader

Du bliver en vigtig koordinerende funktion i organisationen og får kontakt med både leverandører, salg, produktion og kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

Derfor søger vi dig, som kan lide at være den, der skaber overblik, følger op og får tingene til at hænge sammen. Du behøver ikke vide alt fra dag ét – det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og har lyst til at tage ansvar.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt øje for detaljer

  • Er god til at koordinere og bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Har gode kommunikative evner og trives med mange forskellige kontaktflader

  • Er serviceminded og løsningsorienteret

  • Har flair for administrative systemer og IT

  • Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Har erfaring med indkøb, administration, logistik eller koordinering – men det er ikke et krav

Vi tilbyder

Hos Fourcom ApS får du en alsidig rolle med mulighed for at få indblik i hele processen fra indkøb til produktion og salg. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor samarbejde, fleksibilitet og godt købmandskab er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med opstart 01/11-2026 og forventes at løbe til 01/10-26.

Arbejdssted: Fourcom ApS 
Arbejdstid: min. 30 timer 
Ansøgningsfrist: hurtigst muligt 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og CV på ms@fourcom.dk .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit - toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Osaavan projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.

jobs.description:
_Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._

Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

jobs.title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
jobs.description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (m/f)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operations Analyst - New Issues, you will play a key role in supporting securities operations through the analysis, onboarding, monitoring, and maintenance of financial instruments. This position offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of products while contributing to data quality, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance within an international banking environment.

RESPONSABILITIES

Securities Documentation and Analysis

• Review and analyze securities documentation, including prospectuses, final terms, key information documents, term sheets, issuer notices and other supporting documents.
• Assess documentation for completeness, consistency and operational usability before the instrument is created or maintained in the Bank's systems.
• Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies or unclear product features and coordinate clarification with issuers, arrangers, custodians and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain a complete and traceable repository of instrument documentation for operational, audit and regulatory purposes.

Instrument Data Validation

• Validate instrument static data and key economic characteristics, including ISIN, issuer, currency, coupon, maturity, underlying, payment frequency, call features and market classification.
• Ensure instrument data recorded in internal systems is complete, accurate and consistent with the official documentation and approved data sources.
• Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate timely correction with relevant internal teams and external data providers.
• Perform periodic data-quality reviews and support control evidence and audit-trail requirements.

Pricing and Tolerance Controls

• Perform daily or periodic pricing controls and review price movements against established tolerance thresholds.
• Investigate missing, stale or out-of-tolerance prices and obtain supporting information from approved market data sources, issuers or valuation providers.
• Escalate material pricing exceptions and ensure that corrections or overrides are appropriately supported, approved and documented.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of pricing-control procedures and tolerance parameters.

Fiscal Impacts and Fiscal Documentation

• Analyze potential fiscal impacts associated with financial instruments, income events, redemptions and other lifecycle events.
• Collect, validate and maintain fiscal documentation required for withholding-tax treatment, tax relief, reclaim processes and applicable reporting obligations.
• Coordinate with Tax, Compliance, custodians and issuers to clarify the fiscal treatment of instruments and specific events.
• Ensure fiscal assumptions, supporting evidence and operational instructions are clearly documented and escalated when uncertain.

Funds – NAV Control

• Monitor and control Net Asset Value (NAV) information for investment funds using approved sources.
• Investigate missing, stale or unusual NAV movements and coordinate resolution with fund administrators, custodians, distributors and data providers.
• Validate that fund prices and relevant reference data are correctly reflected in internal systems.
• Maintain supporting evidence for NAV exceptions, corrections and escalations.

Onboarding of Structured Products

• Coordinate the operational onboarding of structured products from initial request through instrument readiness.
• Review final terms, term sheets, payoff descriptions, issuer information, relevant risk indicators and operational settlement details.
• Coordinate instrument creation and data validation with internal functions and confirm that required documentation and regulatory information are available before activation.
• Track open onboarding items, dependencies and approvals, escalating issues that could prevent timely product availability.

Monitoring of Specific Events

• Monitor instrument-specific events and issuer notices that may affect product terms, valuation, client positions or operational processing.
• Analyze relevant event information, identify impacted instruments and coordinate required updates in the Bank's systems.
• Communicate material events and operational impacts to the relevant internal stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
• Maintain evidence of the analysis, decisions, actions and follow-up performed.
• Coordination with Issuers and External Parties
• Act as an operational point of contact with issuers, arrangers, custodians, fund administrators and data providers for instrument documentation, reference data, pricing and event-related queries.
• Coordinate the collection of missing information and follow up on outstanding requests within required operational timelines.
• Ensure communications and received documentation are retained in accordance with applicable internal record-keeping requirements.
• Escalate unresolved or material issues to the Senior Operations Analyst or Operations Manager.
• General Responsibilities
• Maintain clear and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Identify operational risks and opportunities to improve data quality, controls and process efficiency.
• Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, process documentation and operational projects.
• Execute assigned controls and reporting activities while maintaining accuracy, traceability and appropriate escalation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in securities operations, instrument data management, product onboarding, pricing controls, funds operations, or related areas.
• Strong understanding of financial instruments, including bonds, equities, investment funds, and structured products.
• Knowledge of securities documentation, instrument static data, and product lifecycle events.
• Understanding of pricing controls, tolerance monitoring, NAV validation, and related operational processes.
• Awareness of withholding tax documentation and tax-related operational impacts is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Fluent English is required; Portuguese is considered an advantage.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

This position is based in Luxembourg and primarily office-based. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. You will work closely with internal teams and external market participants, including issuers, custodians, fund administrators, and data providers. Successful candidates will demonstrate resilience, sound judgment, and a commitment to delivering accurate and timely operational outcomes while contributing to continuous process improvement. Occasional additional effort may be required to meet operational, regulatory, or project-related deadlines.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

At XXXX, diversity is both a value and a strategic priority. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are welcomed, respected, and valued.

If you are looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while contributing to the transformation of an international banking institution, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of XXXX's journey of trust, innovation, and sustainable growth.

jobs.title: Gen B Graduate Program, Process Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position.  



To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  



A program designed for your future

For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations.

Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential. 

Find your path

As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  

In this role as a Process Development Engineer, you'll be part of the the R&D team at Harjavalta smelter, supporting production operations and, when needed, investment projects. You will solve process-related challenges, contribute to long-term assignments linked to strategic objectives, and collaborate closely with production, maintenance, and project personnel.

Responsibilities:

    Respond promptly to requests from production and help resolve process-related problems

    Support production operations and contribute to investment projects when needed

    Contribute to longer-term assignments linked to the company’s strategic objectives

    Combine rapid operational problem-solving with systematic long-term planning

    Review historical reports, external research, and industry publications and assess their relevance to Harjavalta smelter

    Document trials, new materials, operating-window changes, results, and lessons learned for future use

    Collaborate with production, maintenance, and project personnel on process development initiatives

Qualifications: 

    Master of Science in metallurgy, sustainable process metallurgy, extractive metallurgy, process engineering, chemical engineering, process chemistry, or a closely related field



Who you are

We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert. 

What you bring

You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027.

How to apply

Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage.

About Boliden

Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.

Learn more at www.boliden.com.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 20th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.title: Automation Service Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client were looking for an experienced Automation Service Engineer.

You will support customers under service agreements in sectors such as life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, power and heat generation, and energy management. Your work covers engineering and commissioning, both in ongoing service and in projects. Most assignments are in Finland, with the occasional trip abroad. Expect roughly 30-150 travel days a year, depending on how you split your time between remote work and customer sites.

What you will do:
 Handle service requests and help customers solve urgent issues
 Plan and carry out control system hardware and software work, and commission systems on site or remotely
 Maintain the quality of installed base records
 Work closely with service coordinators, project managers, lead engineers, teammates and customer contacts
 Join upgrade and modernization projects from time to time
 Deliver service work efficiently and to a high standard, within contract terms, budget, quality and safety rules

What you bring:
 Degree in automation engineering, or comparable hands-on experience
 Understanding of power plant automation and electrical systems, including PLC design
 Background in engineering work in life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, or power generation
 Good command of Finnish and English, spoken and written. Swedish is a plus.
 A customer-minded, collaborative way of working, with drive to deliver and keep learning
 Familiarity with IT and cyber security, or readiness to learn

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent work experience in automation engineering?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with PLC design for power plant automation or electrical systems?*
- Have you worked on engineering or commissioning in life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, or power generation?*
- Are you fluent in both Finnish and English, spoken and written?*
- Are you able to work onsite in Helsinki, Pirkkala or Vaasa and able to travel 30-150 days a year?*

Please apply as soon as possible with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Helsinki, Vaasa or Pirkkala (hybrid)

jobs.description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

**Did we pique your interest?**

If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

**P.S.: Apply as soon as possible** – we will start reviewing applications and getting to know candidates already during the application period.

jobs.title: Ethics & Compliance Counsel @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Hey Ethics & Compliance professional!**

Are you looking for a diverse role in ethics and compliance within a listed company? Would you be excited to join a team where your work helps build a more sustainable future?

If you are thinking **YES**, please keep reading because we are now looking for **a Legal Counsel, Ethics & Compliance** to join **Stora Enso's Ethics and Compliance Team**!

**In this role**, as a member of the Ethics and Compliance team, you will work with assignments on group level, and, at the same time, serve as the dedicated Ethics and Compliance resource for one or several of Stora Enso's Business Areas. More specifically, you will:

- Serve as the dedicated E&C resource for assigned Business Area(s), providing proactive and reactive legal support including risk assessments, policy interpretation, and compliance investigations

- Monitor relevant regulatory developments in Finland and across the EU, covering anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations

- Draft, update, and implement E&C policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent understanding and application across the organisation

- Develop and deliver E&C training and awareness initiatives, both in person, online and through e-learning programmes

- Contribute as an integrated member of the Group E&C team, taking ownership of group-level projects and supporting the Chief Compliance Officer as needed


Together with your team, you will also attempt to manage information in digital form by using AI, and thus continuously work towards making the routines more efficient and better.

**The Ethics and Compliance team** consists of 6 professionals in several global locations. The team is spread across multiple locations but operates as a genuinely close-knit group, with strong connections and active day-to-day collaboration across geographies. Team members support one another and are encouraged to challenge each other constructively. This is a team where you are expected to contribute, grow, and be heard - ambition is welcomed, and opportunities for development are real.

The position is based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki, but the position also involves occasional, pre-planned travel, mostly within Europe. You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer, who is based in Sweden.

**This position is a great fit for a candidate who has:**

- a Finnish law degree or other education and experience the employer deems relevant for this position;

- at least five years of relevant experience in ethics and compliance in an international environment, whether in-house or at a law firm;

- a strong knowledge of competition law, anti-corruption, trade sanctions, grievance handling and investigations, as well as business ethics and corporate values more broadly;

- a good understanding of the fast-moving regulatory landscape relevant to corporate ethics and compliance, including developments at both the Finnish and EU levels, particularly in the areas of anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations;

- project management experience and experience of rolling out cross-functional programmes in international organisations;

- proven integrity and high ethical standards as well as a strong drive to get things done and the ability to perform well under pressure and meet tight deadlines;

- strong interpersonal skills and a team player mindset; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required. Additional language skills, such as Swedish, German, Polish, Dutch or Chinese, are considered an advantage.


**What Stora Enso offers you:**

**A place for professional growth:** Stora Enso's innovative and high-speed environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally at all stages of your career.

**A diverse working culture:** You get to be part of highly skilled team within an international corporation where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

**A commitment to sustainability:** Sustainability is at the core of Stora Enso's everyday activities, reflecting a strong commitment to compliance and doing things the right way.

**Benefits to support your well-being:** Besides industry-standard salary, you will receive a wide scale of benefits to support your health and well-being – of which we are happy to tell you more in our conversations.

_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. They believe that everything that is made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and their sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion. Stora Enso shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Oy (STEAV, STERV) and Nasdaq Stockholm AB (STE A, STE R). In addition, the shares are traded in the USA as ADRs (SEOAY)._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._
