jobs.title: Director, M&A Legal @ UPM
jobs.description:
**Hey lawyer with a proven track-record in M&A,**

Are you ready to take the lead on strategic transactions in a multinational and multifaceted business environment? Do you find meaning in using your skills to promote sustainable and innovation-driven future in a global material solutions company?

If these sound like your career goals, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **UPM** as a **Director, M&A Legal** in a newly established role.

_UPM is entering an exciting phase where strategic transactions continue to play an important role in shaping our future. We are building a dedicated M&A Legal capability to support that journey, and we are looking for a business-minded lawyer who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership and thrives in helping organizations navigate complex opportunities and change._

**\-Markus Skrabb, VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal**

**As a Director, M&A Legal**, you will join UPM's Legal and Compliance function. The role is preferably based in Helsinki, Finland (or other UPM location), and you will report to VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal.

**In this role,** you will take a leading, hands-on role in mergers, acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions. You will operate across UPM's business areas and geographical footprint, and work with business area leaders, senior management, Legal and Compliance colleagues, other corporate functions and external advisers. In addition to legal support in transactions, you will contribute to developing consistent, efficient and practical M&A legal ways of working across UPM.

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

- leading and coordinating legal workstreams in acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, reorganizations and other strategic transactions;

- providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice to transaction teams, business leadership and senior management;

- coordinating legal due diligence and translating material findings into contractual protections, risk-mitigation actions and clear decision-making materials;

- drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share and asset purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements and ancillary documents;

- planning and coordinating signing, closing and transaction implementation activities;

- working with legal specialists and other functions on merger control, compliance, finance, tax, sustainability, employment, intellectual property, data protection and other relevant matters;

- managing external legal advisers, including scope, resourcing, quality and cost; and

- developing UPM's M&A legal governance, templates, playbooks and transaction tools (including legal tech & AI solutions), and promoting lessons learned and knowledge sharing.


The role involves travel according to transaction activity. UPM's team members currently work based on a hybrid work policy, but due to the collaborative and fast-paced nature of this role, frequent office presence is preferred.

**You could be an ideal candidate if you:**

- are an experienced M&A lawyer with a masters degree in law (or an equivalent legal qualification), who combines strong transaction expertise with sound business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

- have substantial M&A experience from a reputable law firm, an international company or a combination of both, in which context you have led complex domestic and cross-border transactions and have strong experience in legal due diligence as well as assessing, drafting and negotiating transaction documentation;

- take ownership, communicate clearly and move complex matters forward in demanding and time-sensitive situations;

- are a credible leader and influencer who can build trust across the organization, aligning stakeholders with different perspectives, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority;

- understand transaction structures and the interaction between legal, commercial, financial, tax, regulatory and operational considerations;

- can translate legal risks into clear, proportionate and actionable advice and have strong leadership, influencing, project-management, stakeholder-management and negotiation skills;

- work effectively with business leaders, internal specialists, external counsel and counterparties;

- are proactive, structured and comfortable managing several workstreams under pressure; and

- have excellent written and spoken English (Finnish or other relevant language skills are an advantage). Experience in listed-company transactions, carve-outs, joint ventures, merger control, foreign investment screening or post-merger integration is an advantage.


**UPM offers you:**

- **A meaningful role**: You will contribute directly to UPM's strategic development by supporting in transactions of significant importance to the company.

- **A key role with broad exposure**: You will work across UPM's businesses, functions, countries and organizational boundaries, including with senior management.

- **An opportunity to build**: As the first dedicated M&A Legal resource, you will help shape UPM's shared M&A legal practices, governance, tools and institutional knowledge.

- **Inspired and motivated colleagues**: You will join an experienced, collaborative and international Legal and Compliance community.

- **Development opportunities**: The role offers varied and demanding transaction work and broad exposure to UPM's businesses, strategy and operating environment.

- **Responsibility for people and the environment**: UPM's ethical principles embrace people and the environment, and the company continuously works to build a more sustainable future.


**_UPM_** _is a material solutions company, renewing products and entire value chains with an extensive portfolio of renewable fibers, advanced materials, decarbonization solutions, and communication papers. UPM's performance in sustainability has been recognized by third parties, including EcoVadis and the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices. UPM operates globally and employs approximately 15,100 people worldwide, with annual sales of approximately €9.7 billion. UPM's shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd._

jobs.title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

jobs.title: QC Strategic Operation Lead
jobs.description:
The Quality Control department at Alvotech is looking for a dedicated and quality-minded QC Analytical Product Testing Senior scientist with extensive experience in the field, who will be a part of the Quality control team responsible for quality control and release testing of product manufactured at Alvotech.

Scope and responsibility:

Performs routine analytical testing using advanced analytical techniques including Chromatography, Electrophoresis, Compendial and functional testing to support stability, in-process and release analysis.
Expertise in selected analytical techniques and through understanding and overview of all analytical methods applied for product testing and stability testing.
Be aware of compendia and routine testing equipment used during product testing
Complete laboratory documentation and records in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
Proactively communicate analytical issues, deviations, and concerns to relevant stakeholders.
Review and verify analytical data and test results.
Support and lead CAPAs, change control, Document change controls and the investigations for quality issues such as Invalid assay, OOS/OOT/OOE results.
Review and approve technical documentation within the document management system, as required.
Provide support and oversight to other scientists in the laboratory
Proactively ensure the QC Analytical laboratory and equipment is at all times maintained in a state of Inspection readiness.
Perform training of other scientist in laboratory activities and specific methods.
Creates and updates documents for analytical methods
Knowledge about basic tasks in the labs and responsible for analytical methods.
Actively involved and contributes to cross functional activities.

Minimum M.S in technical discipline, (e.g., pharmacy, biotechnology, biochemistry, or a related field)
5-10 years of experience in Pharmaceutical or Biopharmaceutical industry and preferably a project management background/exposure.
Good conceptual, problem solving, and organizational skills – must be detail-oriented and able to work independently and in teams
Independence in assignments. Routinely leads projects and/or supervises small or medium teams. Additionally takes part in larger projects.
Expert knowledge within field of expertise such as methods, techniques as well as relevant procedural/process knowledge
Open to flexible working hours.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What we offer:

An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.
The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.
An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration and inclusion.
Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.

jobs.title: Driller
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

jobs.description:
We are looking for aVibration Engineerwith a main responsibility for delivering noise and vibration engineering analyses,measurementsand solutions for marine projects during the sales and project execution phases. The preferred location for this permanent position isVaasa, Finland.We offer possibility for hybrid work.

Your role and responsibilities

As aVibration Engineer, you will work in a global,innovativeand customer-driven organisation.This delivery-oriented role focuseson providing high-quality engineering analysis and solutionsthatmeet projectneedsand customerexpectations. Your work may include performing noise and vibration measurements during factory acceptance testing of generating sets for advanced passenger and research vessels, as well as presenting vibration analysis results and selected power transmission solutions forcutting-edgehybrid ferry projects. You willbe working as part of our skilled Noise & Vibration Engineering team within Customer Solution Engineering in Power Supply,providing specialistexpertiseacross all marine projects.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Perform noise and vibration measurements during engine factory acceptance tests
* Participatein delivery projects as the Noise & Vibration Engineer in the project team
* Perform torsional vibration calculations in both frequency and time domains
* Perform resilient mounting calculations
* Create technical specificationsin accordance withinternal standards
* Prepare and deliver detailed measurement and calculation reports to customers and classificationsocieties
* Provide technicalexpertiseand support to internal and external stakeholders on noise and vibration topics

To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Fluent written and spoken English and solid MS Office skills. Finnish orSwedish language skill is considered as an advantage
* Analytical mindset and a systematic,proactiveand organised way of working
* Practical problem-solving approach and strong technical reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment, with willingness to learn and adoptnew technologies


The following are considered an advantage:

* Practical experience in linear vibration, airborne noise, torsionalvibrationor modal measurements
* Knowledge of signal processing
* Experience of or interest in engine dynamics
* Experience with data acquisition system hardware and transducers
* Knowledge of relevant ISO standards related to noise and vibration
* Experience with torsional vibration analysis or marine power systems


Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment,ownershipand taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you canaccomplishso much more. Wedontalways get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon bysubmittingyour application through ourcareersportal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

jobs.title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
jobs.description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

Senior Researcher (1 position) Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Law at the University of Lapland is hiring a Senior Research Fellow for the Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North project.

The aim of the Arctic Transitions (AT) project is to critically examine how rapidly changing climatic conditions and a race to extract rare and valuable earth materials have made Arctic regions the focus of new extractive possibilities, as well as a laboratory for testing who controls these possibilities.

To meet this aim, the AT project is hiring a team to conduct comparative multidisciplinary research at locations across Arctic nations to explore:

- How and why changing climatic conditions and new resource demands are shaping extraction activities, infrastructures, security configurations, and governance arrangements.

- The impact of these activities and arrangements on the people and communities who live in these regions.

- How and why energy security and energy transition narratives are being mobilised, by whom, and to what end.

- How and why these activities, infrastructures, configurations and arrangements are connected to, and entangled with, international legal provisions and flows of capital.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to be a core member of a cutting-edge research team, in an area of research that is fast-moving and of geopolitical significance.

It is a full-time, funded, 30-month research position, based in Rovaniemi, with the possibility of remote working. The prospective start date is August 2027, although an earlier start date is possible (to be negotiated).

Work tasks

The successful candidate will be a core and active member of the Arctic Transitions team. They will carry out independent research, work in close collaboration with the projects Principal Investigator, and take on leadership roles within the AT team. In particular, the selected candidate will:

- Conduct independent field research and data collection at selected field locations, to be chosen by the candidate in collaboration with the PI.

- Produce solo- and jointly-authored articles and chapters for top-tier peer-reviewed academic publishers.

- Present research results at national and international conferences.

- Contribute to the planning of an international conference to be hosted in Rovaniemi.

- Contribute to AT project planning and project administration.

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer. Tasks in teaching may occur to a small extent.

Competence

Prospective candidates must:

- Have a PhD in law, policy, geography, economics, environmental studies, sociology, anthropology, science and technology studies, or related field.

- Have a publication record commensurate with their career stage.

- Be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English at an academic level.

Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Finnish will be considered a merit. Demonstrable experience working in a research team will also be considered a merit.

What we Offer

- An opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary research team.

- An opportunity to conduct funded primary data collection (qualitative, quantitative, mixed method, etc.).

- An opportunity to be a part of an international university community.

- An opportunity to build and advance a research portfolio.

- Modern work equipment and facilities.

- A stable organisation to work in.

- Opportunities for professional development.

- Extensive occupational health services.

- Sport, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Prospective candidates should submit their application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Applications must include:

- Cover letter (maximum 1 page)

- Curriculum vitae (cv)

- Research proposal (max. 3 pages, single spaced, 12-point font)

Research proposals should include:

- The region and/or location of the proposed field research

- The methodological approach to data collection and analysis

- A timeline for data collection, analysis, and writing

- Proposed research outputs

Short-listed candidates selected for an interview will be contacted by email. Interviews will be conducted online in January 2027.

Information

For further information about the position, please contact Sean Field, Principal Investigator at firstname.lastname@ulapland.fi and +358 4014 95972. Candidates are encouraged to get in touch with the PI prior to submitting their application.

Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 30 months 1.8.2027 - 31.12.2029, an earlier start date is possible (to be negotiated).
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is made up of a task-specific salary component namely the demand level and a personal salary component namely the performance percentage. The task-specific salary for a senior researcher ranges from demand level 5 (3 366,36 €/ month) to demand level 7 (4 525,66 €/ month). The personal salary component can typically range from 19,1% to 30%. The starting salary for Senior Researcher ranges between 4 009,33 € / month (demand level 5, performance 19,1%) and 5 390,06 € / month (demand level 7, performance 19,1%).

jobs.title: Vi søger en pædagog med hjertet på det rette sted til vores lille og hyggelige private daginstitution. Vuggestuepædagog med interesse for pædagogisk idræt.
jobs.description:
Vil du have et kig ind i idræt, leg og bevægelse? Nu har du chancen for at blive en del af Jellerød Børnegård – en lille privat institution, hvor faglighed og fællesskab vægtes højt.

Vi søger en pædagog i faste stillinger på 34 timer ugentligt.

Vægter du nærhed, tryghed og tæt kontakt til børn og forældre højt? Ønsker du faglig udvikling, et fællesskab og engagerede kolleger? Så er det måske dig vi søger.

Jellerød Børnegård er en lille privat institution, Kokkedals mindste, hvor vi værner om at småt er godt. Vi har plads til 24 vuggestuebørn og 32 børnehavebørn fordelt på fire stuer med hver sin faste stuepædagog. Vi søger en ny pædagog på 34 timer/ugen til den ene vuggestuegruppe på 12 børn og du vil blive pædagog nr. 2 ud af de 3 voksne.

Som pædagog vil du indgå i et fast team tilknyttet stuen. De ældste børn fra begge stuer danner et par dage om ugen deres egen store-gruppe med vores pædagogstuderende som den 7 voksen. Det vil sige stuen har 10 børn flere dage ugentligt til 3 voksne.

 Vi har desuden en køkkeneneansvarlig, som sørger for alle børnenes måltider, som et pædagogiske måltid.

Vi forventer, at du

-          er motiveret til at arbejde med Vuggestuelivet

-          kan trives i en virksomhed, hvor struktur og mange husaftaler allerede er defineret

-          tør overveje, hvorfor du gør som du gør, og dermed reflektere over egen praksis

-          er åben, professionelt imødekommende og respektfuld i din tilgang til børn, forældre og kolleger

-          er nysgerrig, lyttende og nærværende i dialog og samvær

-          kan arbejde med at planlægge, udføre, dokumentere og evaluere din pædagogiske praksis.

-          interesserer dig for at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og det kollegiale fællesskab, da det sociale for os som kolleger er betydningsfuldt.

-          er fleksibel mht. vores åbningstid og opgaver, da vi er et lille hus

Det er en fordel og ikke et krav, hvis du har kendskab til arbejdet med den nye styrkede læreplan og til værktøjerne Hjernen og Hjertet, Sprogtrappen, Sproggaven, dialogisk læsning og Fri For Mobberi.

Vi ser os selv som et hus, der prioriterer høj faglighed og et pædagogisk overskud, så vi kan tilgodese børnenes individuelle behov og interesser. Vi fungerer som én enhed i huset, der lærer af og tager hensyn til hinanden, og vi løfter i flok uagtet titel. Vi er stolte af vores fælles faglighed, fx er hele personalegruppen uddannet i at bruge værktøjerne fra ”Fri For Mobberi” og alle er udannet inden for Via som bevægelsescertificeret institution. Vi har årligt to pædagogiske dage, hvor vi holder lukket og arbejder med vores faglighed. Derudover holdes der 6 personalemøder årligt, der indgår i din årsnorm, ligesom forældremødet og sommerfesten gør.

Vi arbejder altid ud fra vores børnesyn ”Børn gør det godt, når de kan”, hvilket betyder at børn gør det godt, når vi voksne gør det muligt for dem at gøre netop det. Det er derfor de voksnes opgave at få øje på barnets intentioner og adfærd. Det kommer også til udtryk, når vi reflekterer over, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør.

Vi arbejder anerkendende og tydelig i vores kommunikation, både i forhold til børn, forældre og kolleger med afsæt i vores værdigrundlag:

-          Vi er nysgerrige, åbne og imødekomne overfor det vi ikke kender

-          Vi er empatiske og rækker ud for at favne, hjælpe og støtte hinanden

-          Vi vægter tryghed og nærhed højt og skaber små børnefællesskaber hver formiddag

-          Vi giver plads i fællesskabet, og vi giver rum til forskellighed, hvor der tages hensyn til det enkelte individ, kunnen og formående.

-          Vi har respekt for faglighed, vi træffer beslutninger sammen, vi tilegner os ny viden og vi deler viden på tværs at personale- og faggrupper.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Pia Starberg på 93392980, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

 Ansøgning og CV med emnet ”Ansøgning” sendes til pist@jellerod.dk. De indkomne ansøgninger vil blive evalueret løbende, og samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansøgningsfrist: Når rette kandidat er fundet.         

 Tiltrædelse febuar 2027

Læs mere om os på www.Jellerod.dk

 GDPR

 Når du ansøger, accepterer du, at vi registrerer og samler dine personlige oplysninger, som du angiver i forbindelse med din ansøgning. Dette gælder også videopræsentationer, billeder mm.

Vi kan dele din ansøgning med vores medarbejdere, som er involveret i rekrutteringen og tredjeparter, som hjælper os med processen. Dette inkluderer også rekrutteringsfirmaer, som udbyder personlighedstests mm.

jobs.title: Vi søger en pau. El. pædagogmedhjælper med hjertet på det rette sted til vores lille og hyggelige private daginstitution. Børnehave medhjælper med interesse for pædagogisk idræt.
jobs.description:
Vægter du nærhed, tryghed og tæt kontakt til børn og forældre højt? Ønsker du faglig udvikling, et fællesskab og engagerede kolleger? Så er det måske dig vi søger.

Jellerød Børnegård er en lille privat institution, Kokkedals mindste, hvor vi værner om at småt er godt. Vi har plads til 24 vuggestuebørn og 32 børnehavebørn fordelt på fire stuer med hver sin faste stuepædagog. Vi søger en ny Pau el. pædagogmedhjælper til 33 timer/ugen til den ene børnehavegruppe på 14-18 børn, Hvor du vil blive en del af et 3 kløver, med en medhjælper og en pædagog. Som medhjælper vil du indgå i et fast team tilknyttet stuen.

Hver formiddag går en pædagog og en medhjælper fra begge stuer ud og danner par, i deres egen store-gruppe med de ældste børn for at lave aktiviteter i forhold til skoleparathed.

Vi har desuden en køkkeneneansvarlig, som sørger for alle børnenes måltider, som et pædagogiske måltid.

Vi forventer, at du

-          er motiveret til at arbejde med børnehavelivet

-          kan trives i en virksomhed, hvor struktur og mange husaftaler allerede er defineret

-          tør overveje, hvorfor du gør som du gør, og dermed reflektere over egen praksis

-          er åben, professionelt imødekommende og respektfuld i din tilgang til børn, forældre og kolleger

-          er nysgerrig, lyttende og nærværende i dialog og samvær

-          kan arbejde med at planlægge, udføre, dokumentere og evaluere din pædagogiske praksis.

-          interesserer dig for at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og det kollegiale fællesskab, da det sociale for os som kolleger er betydningsfuldt.

-          er fleksibel mht. vores åbningstid og opgaver, da vi er et lille hus

Det er en fordel, hvis du er udadvendt og har lyst til at få kendskab til arbejdet med den nye styrkede læreplan, dialogisk læsning, Fri For Mobberi og Bevægelse. 

Vi ser os selv som et hus, der prioriterer høj faglighed og et pædagogisk overskud, så vi kan tilgodese børnenes individuelle behov og interesser. Vi fungerer som én enhed i huset, der lærer af og tager hensyn til hinanden, og vi løfter i flok uagtet titel. Vi er stolte af vores fælles faglighed, fx er hele personalegruppen uddannet i at bruge værktøjerne fra ”Fri For Mobberi” og alle er udannet inden for Via som bevægelsescertificeret institution. Vi har årligt to pædagogiske dage, hvor vi holder lukket og arbejder med vores faglighed. Derudover holdes der 6 personalemøder årligt, der indgår i din årsnorm, ligesom forældremødet og sommerfesten gør.

Vi arbejder altid ud fra vores børnesyn ”Børn gør det godt, når de kan”, hvilket betyder at børn gør det godt, når vi voksne gør det muligt for dem at gøre netop det. Det er derfor de voksnes opgave at få øje på barnets intentioner og adfærd. Det kommer også til udtryk, når vi reflekterer over, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør.

Vi arbejder anerkendende og tydelig i vores kommunikation, både i forhold til børn, forældre og kolleger med afsæt i vores værdigrundlag:

-          Vi er nysgerrige, åbne og imødekomne overfor det vi ikke kender

-          Vi er empatiske og rækker ud for at favne, hjælpe og støtte hinanden

-          Vi vægter tryghed og nærhed højt og skaber små børnefællesskaber hver formiddag

-          Vi giver plads i fællesskabet, og vi giver rum til forskellighed, hvor der tages hensyn til det enkelte individ, kunnen og formående.

-          Vi har respekt for faglighed, vi træffer beslutninger sammen, vi tilegner os ny viden og vi deler viden på tværs at personale- og faggrupper.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Pia Starberg på 93392980, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Ansøgning og CV med emnet ”Ansøgning” sendes til pist@jellerod.dk. De indkomne ansøgninger vil blive evalueret løbende, og samtaler afholdes løbende.

jobs.title: Project Engineer (electrical and automation), Wärtsilä, Vaasa
jobs.description:

As a Project Engineer, you will manage technical automation solutions, oversee schedules, budgets, and quality standards, and support the project manager in coordinating tasks across stakeholders. Your responsibilities include managing engineering, procurement, and logistics, as well as supporting risk management and reporting. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and external vendors to ensure adherence to contract specifications. The role requires occasional global travel to project sites. While the role demands responsibility and ownership taking, you will work closely with project managers and senior engineers to ensure successful project execution.

You are offered

Work tasks

We are looking for

- Relevant educational background and interest in electrical and automation engineering
- Some years of experience working in project business, preferably in energy sector

- Strong communication and collaboration skills with hefty amount of can-do-attitude; for example act as a substitute to Project Manager and/or Chief Project Engineer when needed

Previous experience from power plants, or retrofit projects is considered beneficial.

As a person you are:
- A good team player with strong problem-solving skills

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Junior Researcher (1 funded PhD position) Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Law at the University of Lapland is recruiting one (1) Junior Researcher for the Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North project.

The aim of the Arctic Transitions (AT) project is to critically examine how rapidly changing climatic conditions and a race to extract rare and valuable earth materials have made Arctic regions the focus of new extractive possibilities, as well as a laboratory for testing who controls these possibilities.

To meet this aim, the AT project is hiring a team to conduct comparative multidisciplinary research at locations across Arctic nations to explore:

- How and why changing climatic conditions and new resource demands are shaping extraction activities, infrastructures, security configurations, and governance arrangements.

- The impact of these activities and arrangements on the people and communities who live in these regions.

- How and why energy security and energy transition narratives are being mobilised, by whom, and to what end.

- How and why these activities, infrastructures, configurations and arrangements are connected to, and entangled with, international legal provisions and flows of capital.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to be a core junior member of a cutting-edge research team, in an area of research that is fast-moving and of geopolitical significance.

It is a full-time, funded, 36-month research position, based in Rovaniemi (Finland), with the possibility of remote working. The prospective start date is August 2027.

Work tasks

The successful candidate will be a core member of the Arctic Transitions team. They will carry out independent research, and work in close collaboration with the projects Principal Investigator (PI). In particular, the selected candidate will:

- Conduct independent research under the supervision of the PI.

- Complete the requirements for the successful completion of their PhD in the Faculty of Law.

- Present research results at national and international conferences.

- Contribute to the planning of an international conference to be hosted in Rovaniemi.

- Contribute to AT project planning and project administration.

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer. Tasks in teaching may occur to a small extent.

Competence

Prospective candidates must:

- Have a Masters degree in law, policy, geography, economics, environmental studies, sociology, anthropology, science and technology studies, or related field.

- Be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English at an academic level.

Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Finnish will be considered a merit.

What we offer

- An opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary research team.

- An opportunity to conduct funded primary data collection (qualitative, quantitative, mixed method, etc.).

- An opportunity to be a part of an international university community.

- Modern work equipment and facilities.

- A stable organisation to work in.

- Opportunities for professional development.

- Extensive occupational health services.

- Sport, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Prospective candidates should submit their application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Applications must include:

- Cover letter (maximum 1 page)

- Curriculum vitae (cv)

- Research proposal (max. 2 pages, single spaced, 12-point font)

Research proposals should include:

- The region and/or location of the proposed legal research.

- The methodological approach to data collection and analysis.

Short-listed candidates selected for an interview will be contacted by email. Interviews will be conducted online in December 2026 and/or January 2027.

The successful candidate will be required to obtain the right to study in Finland (unless already obtained), prior to starting their study period, beginning in August 2027. See the following page for further information on applying for the right to study: https://ulapland.fi/en/for-students/registration/study-rights/

Information

For further information about the position, please contact Sean Field, Principal Investigator at firstname.lastname@ulapland.fi and +358 4014 95972. Candidates are encouraged to get in touch with the PI prior to submitting their application.

Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 36 months 01.08.2027 - 31.07.2030
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is made up of a task-specific salary component namely the demand level and a personal salary component namely the performance percentage. The task-specific salary for a junior researcher ranges from demand level 2 (2 331,67 €/ month) to demand level 3 (2 561,23 €/ month). The personal salary component can typically range from 19,1% to 30%. The starting salary for Junior Researcher ranges between 2 777,02 € / month (demand level 2, performance 19,1%) and 3050,42 € / month (demand level 3, performance 19,1%).

jobs.title: Palvelukoordinaattori / ANNU sosiaalipalvelut, Pirkanmaa
jobs.description:
ANNU sosiaalipalvelut etsii oma-aloitteista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä palvelukoordinaattoria kokoaikaiseen tehtävään kotiin vietäviin sosiaalipalveluihin Pirkanmaalle.

Työ koostuu palvelutoiminnan koordinoinnista ja asiakastyöstä. Koordinointitehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, rekrytointi, työntekijöiden ja asiakkuuksien käytännön järjestelyt sekä muut hallinnolliset tehtävät. Tehtävässä toimitaan palvelujohtajan alaisuudessa.

**Asiakastyön osuus on lähtökohtaisesti noin 50 prosenttia työajasta. Osuus voi toiminnan tarpeiden mukaan kasvaa enintään 100 prosenttiin.** Asiakastyöhön kuuluvat perhetyö ja tehostettu perhetyö, ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö sekä tuettu asuminen.

Työ tehdään Tampereen toimipisteellämme Ratinassa ja asiakaskohteissa Pirkanmaan alueella. Tehtävässä ei ole etätyömahdollisuutta. Koordinointityö ajoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 8–16. **Asiakastyötä tehdään myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.**

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa sosiaali- tai terveysalan AMK-tutkintoa ja tehtävän edellyttämää voimassa olevaa ammattioikeutta. Lisäksi odotamme:

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu-, viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja kykyä asioida englanniksi; ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

- valmiutta käyttää asiakastietojärjestelmiä ja oppia uusia järjestelmiä

- oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

- hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja

- joustavuutta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa.


Aikaisempi kokemus koordinointitehtävistä ja kotiin vietävistä sosiaalipalveluista katsotaan eduksi. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on eduksi asiakastyössä. Tarjoamme merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn, kattavan perehdytyksen sekä esihenkilön ja tiimin tuen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Palkka määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaluokan **G24D** mukaan. Kuukausipalkka on hyväksyttävästä palvelusajasta riippuen **2 811,09–3 071,09 euroa**. Lisäksi maksetaan TES mukaiset työaikalisät.

Palveluslisään oikeuttava työkokemus arvioidaan TES mukaisesti työtodistusten perusteella. Huomioon otetaan tehtävässä olennaisesti hyödyttävä aikaisempi työkokemus.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Sopivan henkilön löydyttyä valinta voidaan tehdä ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Käytämme ensimmäisen kierroksen haastatteluissa Teams-yhteyttä.

Lisätiedot: Tiina Helin, **tiina@annu.fi**, **044 901 8526**.

Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!

Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**

Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Vad gör en vård helppare?**

En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.

Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

- hjälp vid dusch

- uppföljning av hur senioren mår

- stöd för att klara sig hemma

- stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet


Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.

**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**

Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.

Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.

Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?

Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:

Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.

Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.

Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.

Som vård helppare får du:

- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka.

- **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön!


Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.

**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.**

**Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**

Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.title: Research Assistant (Website, Communication, & Research) Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Law at the University of Lapland is recruiting a Research Assistant for the Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North project.

The aim of the Arctic Transitions (AT) project is to critically examine how rapidly changing climatic conditions and a race to extract rare and valuable earth materials have made Arctic regions the focus of new extractive possibilities, as well as a laboratory for testing who controls these possibilities.

To meet this aim, the AT project is hiring a team to conduct comparative multidisciplinary research at locations across Arctic nations to explore:

- How and why changing climatic conditions and new resource demands are shaping extraction activities, infrastructures, security configurations, and governance arrangements.

- The impact of these activities and arrangements on the people and communities who live in these regions.

- How and why energy security and energy transition narratives are being mobilised, by whom, and to what end.

- How and why these activities, infrastructures, configurations and arrangements are connected to, and entangled with, international legal provisions and flows of capital.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to be a core member of a cutting-edge research team, in an area of research that is fast-moving and of geopolitical significance.

This is a 12-month position, based in Rovaniemi, with the possibility of remote working.

The prospective start date is as soon as possible.

Work Tasks

The successful candidate will be a core and active member of the Arctic Transitions team. The central tasks of the successful candidate will be:

- To create and update a captivating and dynamic project website.

- To promote the projects international digital presence.

- To create and promote digital and social media content for the project.

Additionally, the successful candidate will also:

- Find, aggregate, and organise research articles and books using the University of Laplands library resources and cognate search engines as assigned by the employer.

- Find, aggregate, and organise current affairs and media reports using the University of Laplands library resources and cognate search engines as assigned by the employer.

- Contribute to AT project administration.

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer.

Competence

Prospective candidates must:

- Have experience with website construction and design, digital media, and social media content creation.

- Be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English at an academic level.

Prospective candidates should:

- Be pursuing a bachelor's or masters degree.

Previous research assistant experience will be considered a merit.

What we offer

- An opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary team within the Faculty of Law.

- Interesting work tasks as part of an international university community

- Modern work equipment and facilities.

- A stable organisation to work in.

- Opportunities for professional development.

- Extensive occupational health services.

- Sport, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Prospective candidates should submit their application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Applications must include:

- Cover letter (maximum 1 page)

- Curriculum vitae (cv)

Examples of previous digital and web projects are strongly encouraged.

Short-listed candidates selected for an interview will be contacted by email. Interviews will be conducted online in October/November 2026.

Information

For further information about the position, please contact Sean Field, Principal Investigator at firstname.lastname@ulapland.fi and +358 4014 95972.


Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 12 months starting in November or December 2026
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is made up of a task-specific salary component namely the demand level and a personal salary component namely the performance percentage. The task-specific salary for research assistant is demand level 1 (2 120,11 €/ month). The personal salary component can typically range from 19,1% to 30%. The starting salary for Research Assistant is 2 525,05 € / month (demand level 1, performance 19,1%).

jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i Aalborg?
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aalborg?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aalborg.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 

Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

 

Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Alexander Foss Gade 15 i Aalborg.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 

Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aalborg og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aalborg". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores direktør Martin Winther Larsen på tlf. 5354 5054 eller mail mwl@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Klyngemedarbejder til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
Klyngemedarbejder søges til CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som ansat i CenSec kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du får ansvar for, sammen med dine kolleger, at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter som netværksmøder, workshops, konferencer, delegationsture, matchmaking events mv. Du får også til opgave at udvikle og drive forskellige klyngeinitiativer.  

Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

En del af arbejdet udføres i regi af eksternt finansierede projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri.   

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i flere af klyngens interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

  

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.  

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. Samtidig forventer vi en høj grad af teamånd og at du evner at samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger.  

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

Stillingen henvender sig særligt til dig, der er nyuddannet eller har et par års erfaring på arbejdsmarkedet. Vi vægter potentiale og engagement højere end et langt CV, og vi sørger for en grundig oplæring – og forventer at du tager ansvar og initiativ til at få opgaverne løst.  

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får en unik mulighed for at optage ny viden og udvikle dine faglige kompetencer, og udvikle din rolle i organisationen alt efter hvad det er du byder ind med.   

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage. Det er ikke muligt at komme i betragtning til stillingen hvis du ikke har mulighed for fysisk fremmøde i Viborg to dage om ugen.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
 
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
 
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

 

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest fredag den 30. oktober kl. 12.00 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Researcher position in Early Earth Processes
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position in Early Earth Processes, available at the Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB), Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, University of Oslo (UiO).

The position is a full-time position for a period of 3 years.

Starting date no later than 01.01.2027.

Place of work is PHAB, the Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is associated with PHAB and linked to the research theme ‘Planets and Early Earth’, which addresses planet formation, evolution and comparative planetology to identify the initial conditions for habitability and how a planet’s composition and interior influence its ability to nurture a biosphere. The researcher will be part of a project group that explore the conditions for early life and Earth’s evolution as a habitable planet, and specifically, through geochemical investigations of ancient cratons and greenstone belts to understand habitable environments and key geological events (e.g., the Great Oxidation Event) to shed light on crustal and atmospheric processes during Archean-Paleoproterozoic times. The project requires considerable field and laboratory experience, and we seek a candidate with a strong Archean-Paleoproterozoic geological background with a proven record in early Earth surface processes, sedimentology, geobiology, micropaleontology, evolutionary processes, geochemistry and geochronology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geosciences. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Strong publication track record.
  • Extensive Archean craton and greenstone belt field experience.
  • Early Earth geobiological research background using stable isotope systematics (C, N, S, O) and Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS).
  • Experience with U-Pb zircon geochronology and Lu-Hf isotopic systematics.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience working in large-scale multi-partner projects.
  • Experience in paleo sea-temperature proxies and pH modelling of oceans.
  • Experience in advanced methods, e.g. high-resolution synchrotron-based techniques.  
  • Experience in fundraising.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 646000 to 745000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Your Project Vision (1 page) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity) 
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB) is a Norwegian Centre of Excellence that provides a stimulating and well-funded research environment. PHAB’s main goal, based on detailed studies of Earth and our solar system, is to develop predictive models to identify habitable planets around other stars. PHAB research activities comprise three interrelated research themes: (1) Planets and Early Earth, (2) Modern Earth and (3) Exo-Earths. The centre was established in 2023 and will consist of approximately 70 full time and part time professors and researchers, PhD Research Fellows and Postdoctoral Research Fellows.

jobs.title: KERROSHOITAJIA TALVISESONKIIN / HOUSEKEEPERS FOR WINTER SEASON Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Rovaniemi, Osuuskauppa Arina
jobs.description:
Primary location:
ROVANIEMI

KERROSHOITAJA TALVISESONKIIN / HOUSEKEEPER FOR WINTER SEASONOriginal Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Rovaniemi
Haemme yhtä kerroshoitajaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään, joka alkaa mahdollisimman pian. Työsuhde päättyy 31.3.2027.
Työsuhteen sopimustyöaika on 80 h / 3 viikkoa. Työ on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä, ja työvuorot voivat sijoittua viikon kaikille päiville klo 8.00–16.00 välille.

We are looking for one Housekeeper for a fixed-term position starting immediately. The employment relationship will end on 31 March 2027.

The contract hours are 80 hours per three weeks. The work is mainly daytime work, and shifts may be scheduled on any day of the week between 8:00 and 16:00.

Kerroshoitajana olet tärkeä osa vierailijoidemme onnistunutta majoituskokemusta. Työsi näkyy päivittäin asiakkaiden viihtyvyydessä ja hotellimme laadukkaassa asiakaskokemuksessa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat hotellihuoneiden ja yleisten tilojen siisteydestä huolehtiminen sekä muut kerroshoidon tiimin päivittäiset työtehtävät, kuten pölyjen pyyhintä, imurointi, lattioiden puhdistus ja vuodehuolto.

As a Housekeeper, you play an important role in creating an excellent guest experience. Your work contributes directly to our guests' comfort and the overall quality of our hotel operations. The role includes cleaning and maintaining guest rooms and public areas, as well as other daily housekeeping duties such as dusting, vacuuming, mopping floors, and changing bed linens.

Tehdään yhdessä ihan tavallisia töitä, meiltä saat poikkeuksellisen hyviä etuja

Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista. Tämä tarkoittaa etuja muun muassa ruokaostoksista, ravintoloista, hotelleista, matkailusta ja vapaa-ajasta. Eduista voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ.

Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan 12,97–14,33 € / h, johon vaikuttavat koulutuksesi ja alan kokemuksesi. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla 1,30 € / tehty työtunti.

Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen työntekijä voi tehdä työnsä turvallisesti, työrauhassa ja osana arvostavaa tiimiä. Uskomme, että parhaat asiakaskokemukset syntyvät hyvinvoivasta työyhteisöstä ja yhdessä onnistumisesta.

jobs.description:
Etsitkö mukavaa ja joustavaa palkkatyötä ilman koulutus- tai tutkintovaatimusta? Haluatko itse vaikuttaa omaan työmäärääsi sekä siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet? Koetko muiden ihmisten auttamisen tärkeäksi ja haluat tehdä työtä, josta jää hyvä mieli?

Mikäli vastasit yllä oleviin kysymyksiin kyllä, suosittelemme sinulle henkilökohtaisen avustajan töitä Aarre Avustajilla. Alta löydät lisätietoja Aarre Avustajista ja henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä sekä linkin työnhakulomakkeeseen, jonka kautta voit hakea meille helposti töihin ilman erillistä CV:tä. Otathan rohkeasti yhteyttä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää!

Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.html

TÖITÄ TARJOLLA HENKILÖKOHTAISENA AVUSTAJANA
Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme uusia henkilökohtaisia avustajia tärkeään, mutta joustavaan avustustyöhön. Työ on palkkatyötä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sopii niin kokopäiväistä, osa-aikaista, satunnaista kuin keikkatyötäkin etsivälle hyvälle tyypille. Henkilökohtaisena avustajana saat itse määritellä, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet, joten avustajan työ sopii myös toisen työn tai opiskelun ohelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla erityistä koulutusta avustajan työhön, vaan oikea asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimmät ominaisuudet erinomaiselle henkilökohtaiselle avustajalle. Aarre Avustajilla saat jatkuvan tuen ja ohjauksen omalta toimihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan asioittesi tai kysymyksiesi kanssa yksin, sen lupaamme.

MITÄ HENKILÖKOHTAINEN APU ON JA MITÄ AVUSTAJA TEKEE?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, jossa henkilökohtainen avustaja toimii asiakkaan käsinä ja jalkoina toteuttaen niitä toimia, jotka asiakas tekisi itse, mutta ei niistä vamman tai sairauden vuoksi selviä yksin. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on auttaa asiakasta jokapäiväisissä arjen tehtävissä niin kotona kuin myös kodin ulkopuolella.

Avustustehtävät ovat usein tavallisia arkisia askareita, joita me kaikki toteutamme myös omassa arjessamme. Avustajan työhön ei siten sisälly tehtäviä, jotka vaativat erillistä, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tutkintoa, vaan kuka tahansa voi toimia avustajana. Avustustehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi asiakkaan avustaminen kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa, ruokailussa tai ruoanlaitossa, pukeutumisessa, harrastuksissa tai kodinhoidossa.

MILLAINEN HENKILÖ SOPII AVUSTAJAKSI?
Voimme useiden satojen henkilökohtaisten avustajien työnantajana todeta, että henkilökohtaisiksi avustajiksi sopivat parhaiten henkilöt, joilla on oikea asenne tärkeää avustamistyötä kohtaan. Avustajan on hyvä olla luotettava, positiivinen, avulias, ahkera ja ihmisläheinen henkilö.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aikaisempaa vastaavaa työkokemusta, sillä jokainen uusi avustaja perehdytetään kattavalla perehdytyksellä Aarre Avustajien omassa Aarre Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista. Avustamis- ja hoiva-alan kokemuksesta tai koulutuksesta voi kuitenkin olla hyötyä joidenkin asiakkaiden kohdalla.

MILLAISIA TYÖVUOROJA ON TARJOLLA JA VOINKO ITSE VAIKUTTAA NIIHIN?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, joka tapahtuu niin arkisin kuin myös viikonloppuisin ja mahdollisia työvuoroja on usein tarjolla aamusta iltaan. Aarre Avustajilla voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, miten paljon ja milloin haluat työskennellä sekä millaiselle asiakkaalle. Pyrimme yhdistämään asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet ja avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sopivat kaikille. Saat aina tavata mahdollisen uuden asiakkaan ennen asiakassuhteen aloittamista, ja mikäli koet, että jokin asia ei toimi niin kuin ajattelit, voimme yhdessä etsiä sinulle sopivan vaihtoehdon. Meillä voit tehdä halutessasi avustajan töitä niin monelle asiakkaalle kuin itse haluat.

HAKEMINEN
Rekrytointimme on jatkuvaa, joten täytäthän työnhakulomakkeen tarkasti. Muista lisätä työnhakulomakkeeseen kaikki sinulle sopivat kunnat, joissa voit työskennellä, niin osaamme olla sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun löydämme sinulle sopivan asiakkaan. Työnhakulomakkeen täyttäminen ei vielä sido sinua mihinkään.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.
