jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

Viestit oman vastuualueesi asioista sekä huolehdit osaltasi sujuvasta tiedonkulusta. Lisäksi perehdytät uusia työntekijöitä, jaat osaamistasi sekä autat tiimiä onnistumaan päivittäisessä työssä. Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?

Vastuumyyjänä onnistut tehtävässä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja toimeen tarttuva. Sinulla on positiivinen työskentelyote sekä hyvät viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Pystyt ohjaamaan osaston toimintaa, johtamaan työvuoroa sekä antamaan palautetta. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä, sekä kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Vastuumyyjältä edellytämme aikaisempaa työkokemusta myyjän tehtävistä, ja eduksi katsomme kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vaativamman työn lisään. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 2 214,00 €–2 517,48 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. **About Sine Engineering**

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technology, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

**Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere.**

We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive **Purchasing Specialist** to develop and manage our Finland offices end-to-end procurement activities from creating purchase orders and validating supplier confirmations to ensuring timely deliveries and resolving shortages. You will maintain daily communication with suppliers, support onboarding and RFQ processes.

What we need is a strong procurement professional who will thrive in a global role with a lot of independence and responsibility, with the potential to grow into team leadership.

In this position you will be building the procurement process in Finland together with your international colleagues and manager. Your colleagues and stakeholders are spread across several countries, so you'll work in an international collaboration setup, but you will as well work closely with our Engineering and Finance teams, so you should have a good understanding of the Finnish procurement field.

With us you'll learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company. Because this is a key role in Finland, it is also an opportunity to develop something new, and a possibility grow into a leadership position.

[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC10: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step

 - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees

 - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion

 - Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates

 - Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality

 - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals

 - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders

 


SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools)

 - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft.

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence

 - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year

 - You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

- Täsmällistä ongelmanratkaisu- ja oivalluskykyä

Vatupassilaista kulttuuria leimaa perheomisteisen yrityksen reiluus, joustavuus ja oikeudenmukaisuus. Meillä omista pidetään huolta. Ja se tarkoittaa sitä, että vastuuta kannetaan yhdessä, luotetaan toinen toisiimme ja autetaan työkaveria ilman mikromanageerausta.

Haku on käynnissä 25.10.2026 saakka, mutta pesti täytetään heti sopivan tyypin löydyttyä. Älä siis jää empimään, vaan laita hakemusta heti tulemaan!

Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.
Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko omassa tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.
Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana. Piihovissa sinua odottaa lähes 30 hengen tiimi valmiina hommiin kanssasi!

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: marraskuussa sopimuksen mukaan
Haku päättyy: 21.10.2026. Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian, sillä saatamme haastatella jo hakuaikana ja valintapäätös tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.
📞Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa liikennemyymäläpäällikkö Milla Seppälä joko puhelimitse 0447705 793 tai sähköpostitsemilla.seppala@sok.fi.

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessa sso.fi/toihinmeille.

jobs.title: SMB Account Executive (New Business)
Chef - Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 


WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

jobs.title: Service Instructor
jobs.description:
**Come and join us as a Service Instructor in Cleaning Services for Commercial Cleaning in the Uusimaa region!**

Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the daily operations of a team and help ensure high-quality service delivery? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work under a supervisor as a Service Instructor and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating procedures. You will act as a key link between employees, management, and customers, supporting your supervisor in daily operations. However, the position does not include direct managerial responsibility.

Customer service is a central part of the role, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. In this position, you will have a direct impact on customer experience and the smooth running of customer relationships. Therefore, active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-oriented approach are essential.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Ensuring the quality of daily cleaning operations and planning work allocation, as well as using resources cost-effectively

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement suggestions

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Customer collaboration

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- Experience in cleaning work and knowledge of commercial cleaning services

- The ability to guide and support a work community in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful working atmosphere, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and initiative

- A customer-focused approach and positive attitude

- The ability to work under pressure and solve problems

- The ability to communicate verbally and in writing in either Finnish or English. Language skills play an important role in this guidance-oriented position to ensure understanding of work instructions, safe working practices, and the management of employment-related matters. If one language is fluent, the other can be at a basic level. We value a diverse work community where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength.

- A valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen

- A valid driver's license


**We offer you:**

- A permanent, full-time employment contract of 37.5 hours per week

- Work shifts on weekdays and weekends, starting from 6:00 a.m. We expect flexibility to work different shifts when needed.

- A start date agreed upon together

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment conditions, a safe working environment, and a strong commitment to employee well-being

- A competitive salary in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Service Employees, €2,235/month


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect and do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work community.

**Did you know?**

People enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS score is an outstanding 55! This is reflected in our daily work through mutual respect and a genuine commitment to succeeding together.

N-Clean has succeeded in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-oriented and responsible working life. In 2024, we were chosen as the Most Human-Centric Workplace in Finland, and in 2025 we placed third in the competition and achieved 3rd place in the Finlands Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category. This recognition highlights our people-focused recruitment approach, where meaningful encounters, appreciation, and candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join our top team!**

**Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20 October 2026.**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.

jobs.title: Hertz Sandefjord søker helgevakter
jobs.description:
Er du en av våre nye kollegaer ved vår avdeling på Sandefjord lufthavn? Jobben passer for deg som har god sans for logistikk, rutiner, er utadvendt, samt liker å snakke med folk og jobbe med kundebehandling.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Håndtering og oppfølging av kundehenvendelser i butikk, epost og telefon.
  • Planlegging, kontroll og disponering av bilflåten på avdelingen.
  • Utleie av biler, samt salg av våre produkter og tjenester.
  • Kontroll og oppfølging av leiekontrakter og daglige gjøremål.
  • Sikkerhetskontroll og klargjøring av biler.

Du har:

  • Hatt førerkort for personbil i minst 1 år.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige fremstillingsevner på norsk og engelsk.
  • Evne til, og trives med, å jobbe i en fartsfylt hverdag.
  • Mulighet til å jobbe i skiftordning.
  • Følgende egenskaper: liker å snakke med folk, har godt humør og er salgs- og serviceinnstilt, ansvarsfull, fleksibel og pålitelig.

Du får:

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Et aktivt og morsomt miljø.
  • Strukturerte arbeidsforhold.
  • Muligheter for personlig utvikling og for å lære mye om mennesker
  • Konkurransedyktige vilkår og attraktive bonusavtaler.

 

Som ansatt i Hertz er du med på laget til Norges største bilutleieselskap, der du er en del av et engasjert team som er opptatt av å levere kvalitet til hver eneste kunde.
Vår avdeling i Sandefjord er tilgjengelig alle dager så arbeidstiden vil være skiftbasert.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hertz – et ledende bildelingsselskap. Hertz er representert mer enn 150 land på samtlige kontinenter med over 11 000 lokasjoner. Hertz er Norges største bildelingsselskap og en betydelig aktør i den raskt voksende delingsøkonomien. De seneste ti årene har vi hatt en årlig vekst på ca. 20 prosent, og har nå over 500 utleiepunkter, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Bilflåten i Norge består av flere enn 10 000 nye biler fra verdens ledende produsenter, som leies ut via et landsdekkende nettverk. Hertz vil være førstevalget innen bilutleie og en markant aktør i den nye delingsøkonomien med heldigitale delings- og mobilitetsløsninger. Vi har store ambisjoner for fremtiden og ser et betydelig vekstpotensial i at stadig flere vil leie og dele biler fremfor å eie selv. Samtlige lokasjoner i Hertz Norge er miljø- og kvalitetssertifisert gjennom standardene ISO 14001, 9001 og 45001 (HMS).

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Kangasalla palkitseva ja kannustava työilmapiiri ovat työssä viihtymisen ja onnistumisen kulmakiviä. Hyvä työilmapiiri säteilee hyvää koko kaupunkiin. Meillä Kangasalla arvostetaan oman osaamisen ja työyhteisön kehittämistä, joten kaupunki tarjoaa paljon koulutusmahdollisuuksia. Meillä saa kokeilla, onnistua ja erehtyä. Kaikista kokeiluista opimme uutta. Me tuemme ja kannustamme sinua pitämään huolta itsestäsi niin työssä kuin vapaa-ajallakin. Työhyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi meillä on käytössä uintietuus Kangasalan uimahallissa, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaetuus (Epassi) sekä hyvät ennaltaehkäisevät työterveyshuoltopalvelut. Kangasalan kaupungille on neljännen kerran myönnetty Hyvän mielen työpaikka -merkki, joka kuvaa tekemäämme työtä henkilöstömme mielen hyvinvoinnin saralla.

Avoinna oleva määräaikainen liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä ajalle 2.11.2026-31.7.2028 sijoittuu sivistyskeskukseen, hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueelle. Hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueeseen kuuluu kirjasto-, kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistäminen sekä taiteen perusopetus ja kansalaisopistopalvelut.

Liikuntapalvelut edistää kaupunkilaisten kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja motivoi heitä liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu liikunnanohjaus, liikuntaneuvonta, kouluyhteistyö, liikuntatilojen tilavarausten hallinnointi sekä erilaiset tapahtumat. Liikunnanohjaus tapahtuu eri toimintaympäristöissä sisältäen myös sosiaalisen median kanavat.

Hakijalta edellytetään liikunnanohjaajan tutkintoa (AMK), liikuntaneuvojan tutkintoa tai muuta vastaavaa soveltuvaa alan koulutusta. Työ vaatii itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työtehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus on KVTESin mukainen ja tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2700,00 €/kk. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Työ- ja opiskelutodistukset tarkistetaan mahdollisessa haastattelutilaisuudessa. Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista.

Hakemukset pyydetään jättämään 21.10.2026 klo 15 mennessä. Rekrytointikeskustelut pyritään järjestämään viikolla 44.

Liity hyvän piiriin ja tule töihin Kangasalle!

Mikäli muutat Kangasalle kauempaa, autamme mielellämme vuokra-asunnon haussa.

jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer - Consulting Manager
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Job description
Requisition ID:  1730791
Applied AI Engineer - Consulting Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

You will work across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning Financial Services, the Public Sector, and the Private Sector. Our Applied AI Engineering teams deliver production-grade AI systems in regulated financial institutions as well as government, health, infrastructure, consumer, industrial and energy organizations. This cross-sector model gives you broad exposure to different regulatory environments, data landscapes and operating models, while building deep engineering capability that transfers across industries.

Role purpose

Operate as a hands on engineer within a squad, taking ownership of defined components and delivering AI capabilities (e.g., agents, RAG pipelines) that meet enterprise standards for reliability, security and observability. Strengthen your foundations through the Applied AI Engineering Academy while taking on more responsibility for solution shaping and stakeholder engagement.

Your key responsibilities

Client facing engineering & delivery

• Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders; translate requirements into engineering tasks; support workshops, demos and solution reviews; drive adoption through testing and iteration.
Solution design & implementation
• Design and implement RAG pipelines, agents, microservices and integrations; apply monitoring, evaluation and Responsible AI guardrails.
Product mindset & continuous improvement
• Shape MVP scope, backlog and release planning; capture reusable patterns and contribute to shared accelerators.

What we're looking for

• Strong Python/TypeScript; async patterns; API design; testing/CI; microservice fundamentals.
• Hands on LLMs, embeddings, vector databases; retrieval strategies and grounding.
• Cloud engineering (Azure preferred), Docker/Kubernetes, serverless; secure networking/IAM.
• Data engineering fundamentals (Spark/Databricks; ETL/ELT) and operational handover.
• Consulting behaviors: stakeholder engagement and clear, client ready communication.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluent written and spoken English, French/German is a plus.

Ideally, you'll also

• Document/graph stores; streaming (Event Hub/Kafka); cloud architecture exposure and governance credentials.

What we offer you
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services (m/f)
jobs.employer: Deloitte Tax & Consulting Deloitte Tax & Consulting S.A R.L.
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services

Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting
Job Function:  Consulting Services
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14080

Job Description:  

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Economics, Engineering, or Information Technology (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
• Around 3-4 years of relevant experience in the banking industry, with demonstrated exposure to middle- and/or back-office operations.
• Solid knowledge of multiple banking value chains, including but not limited to:  

1. Payments & Cash Management
2. Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
3. Investment & Portfolio Management
4. Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
5. Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
6. Lombard & Collateral Management
7. Trade Finance
8. Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations

• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.
• Pragmatic, autonomous, solution-oriented, and comfortable working at speed across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to produce clear, structured, and professional documentation.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior leadership and subject matter experts.
• Fluent in English; French and/or any additional language is an asset.
• Ability to efficiently manage multiple deliverables and priorities in a fast-paced, high-ambition environment.

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Job Title:  AI & Data - Technical Senior Consultant / Manager

Job Function:  Technology & Cyber Security
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14201

Job Description:  

On site

Full time

Your future team

Join our Artificial Intelligence & Data (AI&D) team and work with colleagues from diverse backgrounds to help clients turn data into actionable insights. We partner with organizations across industries to design and implement data platforms, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions and innovation. You will collaborate closely with experts in technology, business and risk to deliver end-to-end data solutions.

The advantages of joining us

1. Career growth, your way: access to structured training, certifications and a clear progression path.
2. Global impact, local connections: work on international projects while supporting clients in Luxembourg and the Greater Region.
3. Innovative work that matters: contribute to modern data architectures, AI solutions and advanced analytics use cases.
4. Inclusive, flexible culture: join a collaborative team where diverse perspectives are valued and flexible working arrangements are supported
5. Build your network: connect with professionals across Deloitte's global network and participate in industry events.

How you'll contribute to our success

1. Translate business needs into technical designs: Work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and turn them into architectures, data models and solution designs for Data & AI platforms.
2. Engineer data & AI solutions: Design and implement data platforms, data pipelines, integrations, analytics solutions and AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, scalability, performance and security.
3. Industrialise analytics & AI: Move solutions from proof of concept to production, set up monitoring, testing and deployment practices, and embed data quality and governance in the delivery.
4. Guide technical delivery: Provide technical leadership to project teams, review designs and code, and coach junior engineers on best practices in data engineering and AI
5. Learn, innovate & share: Explore emerging technologies such as GenAI, LLMs, data mesh and the modern data stack, contribute to reusable assets, and share knowledge to grow the team's capabilities.

Your skills

Must-have

•    Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, Economics, Information Systems or a related field.
•    4-6 years of experience in data-related roles (data engineering, analytics, BI, data science, data governance, AI project delivery, or data strategy consulting).
•    Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).
•    Strong collaboration skills and structured communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
•    Problem-solving mindset with a genuine interest in how data and AI can create business value.
•    Ability to create compelling presentations and tell stories with data for senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

•    Hands-on experience with SQL and at least one language used in data (Python, Scala, R…).
•    Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, integrations or data models.
•    Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data stack tools.
•    Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) or data orchestration/transformation tools (dbt, Airflow…).
•    Experience designing, developing or deploying AI/ML solutions in a production or pilot environment.
•    Familiarity with the AI lifecycle, and the ability to collaborate with data scientists and engineers on AI use cases.
•    Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, or advanced analytics projects.
•    Relevant certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP, DAMA, TOGAF…).

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Job Title:  Management Assistant, Deloitte Solutions

Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting
Job Function:  Consulting Services
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14178

Job Description:  

Your future team

Deloitte Solutions is a Luxembourg Professional of the Financial Sector (“PSF”) and EU regulated company providing managed services to financial institutions across Europe. We combine financial, compliance and tax expertise with dedicated technology to deliver tax, regulatory and transaction reporting, as well as AML/KYC managed services.

The Management Assistant supports the PSF Management team in governance, control, documentation, reporting, financial follow up and HR activities.

The advantages of joining us

• A coordination role at the crossroads of governance, operations and finance within a Luxembourg Professional of the Financial Sector.
• Direct collaboration with central functions and service delivery teams, with visible impact on efficiency and controls.
• Access to Deloitte's methodologies, tools and training to develop your management support skills.
• An inclusive, international working environment with flexible work arrangements.

How you'll contribute to our success

You will perform a broad range of management support activities, including:

Governance, documentation and meetings

• Manage central documentation and document management projects, including handling digital mail and contracts and tracking signatures.
• Prepare and format governance presentations, letters, contracts, policies and procedures.
• Schedule governance and oversight meetings.
• Draft meeting minutes and maintain/follow up action logs.
• Support policy/procedure maintenance and audit document collection and tracking.

Reporting and financial follow up

• Generate, share and save recurring operational and management reports, and support input for regulator reporting.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

PHD IN ADVANCING SAFE AND SUSTAINABLE BY DESIGN (SSBD) ASSESSMENT OF NOVEL BIO-BASED POLYMERS: INTEGRATION OF NEW APPROACH METHODOLOGIES AND COMPUTATIONAL MODELLING FOR SAFETY ASSESSMENT (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 Months (14 +22+12 )
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in environmental science/engineering, toxicology, pharmacy, or a closely related field.

Experience and skills
• Familiarity with in vitro toxicology methods and/or New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) is an asset.
• Interest in or experience with computational approaches and modelling is a considered an asset.
• Experience in risk assessment and knowledge of the regulatory landscape is an asset.
• Basic understanding of Sustainability Assessment and Life Cycle Impact Assessment methodologies is valued.
• Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and international research environment.

Soft skills

• Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously under the guidance of a supervisory team.

Language skills

jobs.description:
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN AI-BASED ENERGY MANAGEMENT OF RESILIENT MICROGRIDS WITH SECOND-LIFE BATTERY (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 20 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will contribute to the ENERGY-RESILIENT-UA project, which aims to support vulnerable communities in Ukraine through resilient, low-carbon energy systems based on second-life electric vehicle batteries, solar PV, and advanced AI-based control. The project addresses the urgent need for reliable backup power for critical services such as schools, clinics and water facilities, while reducing dependence on diesel generators and promoting circular economy solutions.

The work will mainly focus on modelling, algorithm development, simulation, validation and remote technical support from Luxembourg. The successful candidate will not be required to travel to Ukraine.
You will be mainly in charge of:

• Developing and implementing AI-based and safety-aware control algorithms for microgrids integrating second-life EV batteries, solar PV and critical loads.
• Designing grid-forming and resilient control strategies to ensure stable operation under severe grid disturbances, outages and high uncertainty.
• Optimizing battery system operation, including state-of-charge management, reliability, lifetime-aware operation and backup power availability.
• Building simulation models of microgrids, second-life battery systems, solar PV generation and critical community loads.
• Validating the proposed control strategies using real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
• Providing remote technical support for the preparation, analysis and monitoring of a pilot microgrid demonstration in Ukraine, in collaboration with project partners.
• Analyzing technical performance, cost savings and emissions reduction compared with diesel-based backup solutions.
• Contributing to project deliverables, technical reports, scientific publications and dissemination activities.
• Collaborating closely with academic, industrial and humanitarian partners through remote meetings and digital collaboration tools.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• PhD in electrical engineering, energy systems, control engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field.
• Strong background in at least one of the following areas:
- Power systems and microgrids
- Battery energy management systems
- Renewable energy integration
- Control systems
- Artificial intelligence or machine learning for energy applications

Experience and skills
• Previous experience in one or more of the following topics would be highly valued:
o Microgrid modelling, simulation and control
o Battery energy storage systems, preferably including second-life batteries
o Energy management systems for PV-battery systems
o AI-based optimization, reinforcement learning, predictive control or data-driven control
o Real-time simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing or laboratory validation
• Good programming skills, preferably in Python and/or MATLAB/Simulink.
• Experience with power system simulation tools, real-time simulation platforms or optimization frameworks is considered an asset.
• Knowledge of battery operation, state of charge, ageing, safety constraints or battery management systems is an advantage.
• Ability to translate research concepts into practical algorithms and demonstrable solutions.
• Good analytical, problem-solving and scientific writing skills.
• Ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary project team.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with international partners in a remote working environment.
• Interest in applied research with societal impact, humanitarian energy systems and sustainable reconstruction.

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written, is required.
• Knowledge of French is considered an asset.
• Other relevant languages are also an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
