jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. dokaz o prijavljenom prebivalištu u RH 4. dokaz o stečenoj razini i vrsti obrazovanja 5. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

jobs.title: Hotelová hospodyně, Vedoucí provozu stravovacích, ubytovacích a dalších zařízení
ELEKTRIKÁŘ (M+Ž), Stavební a provozní elektrikáři
jobs.description:
ELEKTRIKÁŘ (M+Ž)

Pracovní náplň: Instalace, opravy a údržba elektrických rozvodů NN a VN Montáž a zapojování rozvaděčů, elektrických zařízení a komponentů Pravidelné revize a kontroly elektrických zařízení Vyhledávání a diagnostika závad na elektrických zařízeních Operativní řešení poruch a havárií Práce s měřicími přístroji Čtení a práce s technickou dokumentací.
Požadavky: Minimálně střední odborné vzdělání s výučním listem v oboru elektro. Vyhláška č.250/2021 Sb. min. §6 NV E2A. Řidičský průkaz sk.B. Čtení elektrických schémat. Práce s ručním nářadím. Základní znalost práce s PC. Ochota sebevzdělávání. Spolehlivost.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
Zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr, směnný provoz (krátký/dlouhý týden) nebo denní provoz 37,5 hod./týden; 25 dnů dovolené; příspěvek na penzijní připojištění; mimořádné odměny; elektronické stravenky Pluxee; stabilní prostředí společnosti patřící do mezinárodní kapitálové skupiny ORLEN; nástup možný ihned.

Hlásit se:
- Ing. Nikola Papežová
zaslat životopis nikola.papezova@orlenservice.cz, tel.: 705879209

jobs.title: Montéři kovových konstrukcí, Montéři kovových konstrukcí
AUTOELEKTRIKÁŘ - DIAGNOSTIK (M+Ž), Mechanici a opraváři nákladních automobilů
jobs.description:
AUTOELEKTRIKÁŘ - DIAGNOSTIK (M+Ž)

Zajišťování servisu a oprav na nákladních vozidlech. Provádění diagnostiky, montáž, údržba a servis el. systémů, spolupráce s kolegy v servisu. Zajišťování odborných prohlídek a preventivní údržby, práce s interním systémem, výjezdy k poruchám.
Vzdělání v oboru je výhodou, ne podmínkou.
Praxe v oboru, zájem a záliba v autech je vítána.

jobs.title: AV Designer
jobs.description:
Big ideas in, flawless shows out. You're the calm voice in the control room – three steps ahead of everyone. Your next stage is at FLIK.

**The role**

FLIK is looking for an AV Designer who understands how live events work from planning to execution.

You combine technical understanding, practical production experience and strong problem-solving skills. You can design reliable technical setups, anticipate issues before production, and find solutions when plans change. You'll be the link between our Event Managers, Designers and Technical team. You'll translate 3D designs and client wishes into workable technical plans, challenge them when needed, and lead the team that brings them to life.

We deliver more than 2,000 IR hybrid events every year across the Nordics through our own platform VideoSync, ranging from simple audiocasts to cutting-edge Virtual AGMs.

**What you'll do**

- Plan technical setups for our studio, on-site and hybrid events

- Anticipate technical risks and solve problems before and during productions

- Prepare plans, budgets, equipment requirements and documentation

- Coordinate with internal teams, customers, freelancers and suppliers

- Participate hands-on in productions and technical operations

- Improve our studio architecture and ways of working

- Take ownership of technical production in our most important events

- Place customer needs first in your decisions


**Technical environment**

You'll work with technologies such as:

- vMix, Madmapper, Lightkey, Companion and other software-based AV tools

- AVoIP protocols such as NDI, Dante, ArtNet, OSC

- PTZ systems, audio systems, automation

- Production networking

- LED volumes, vision mixing

- WebRTC, RTMP and streaming platforms


You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for strong general technical understanding and the ability to see how the pieces work together.

**Who you are**

- Have 5+ years of experience in live production, broadcasting, streaming, events or a similar technical environment

- Understand the whole production chain, not just your own technical area

- Can plan practical solutions based on real production experience

- Think ahead and spot potential problems early

- Take ownership and move things forward without guidance

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Can explain and justify technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Want to improve how we work, not just deliver the next production

- Are happy to get your hands dirty and participate in production

- Have fluent English and Finnish skills


**What we offer**

- A high degree of ownership in a flat, self-managed organisation

- A varied role combining planning, problem-solving and hands-on production

- The opportunity to influence our technical environment and processes

- A technically strong and supportive team

- Hybrid work model across our Ruoholahti premises, on-site or remote when applicable

- Opportunities to work across the Nordics and Europe


The position is full-time and permanent. The salary range for this position is €4,000–5,200/month + benefits. Our company benefits include high-end IT equipment, comprehensive health insurance, lunch/activity benefit and share option program opportunities, among others.

**About Inderes**

Inderes' mission is to connect listed companies and investors. Our customer base includes over 400 listed companies that rely on us for better investor communication.

Our Events business delivers over 2,000 online and hybrid events annually across the Nordics. We operate with a high degree of ownership, where teams are flat, decisions are made close to the problem, and roles evolve over time.

Inderes Playbook: https://group.inderes.com/files/documents/Inderes%20Playbook%20v4.pdf

**Application process**

Submit your CV and application via TeamTailor: https://careers.inderes.com/jobs/8455404-av-designer You may apply in Finnish or English.

We're more interested in how you approach technical problems than in polished applications. We'll aim to conduct preliminary Teams interviews, followed by in-person interviews for selected applicants.

The position will be filled when we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
jobs.description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt.

Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt.

Vi leder efter de rigtige.

Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel.

Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen.

Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer.

Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne.

Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov

Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt.

Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson

Det lægger vi vægt på
Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt

Du skal ikke være perfekt.
Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson

Hvilke opgaver kan du få?
Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring.

Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb

Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil.

Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson

Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven
Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre.

Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i.

Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match.

For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson

Det får du hos os
  • opgaver, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer
  • tæt dialog og opfølgning
  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb
  • et bureau med rødder i socialpædagogisk praksis
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og undervisning
  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

Praktisk information
  • Arbejdet foregår primært på Sjælland
  • Opgaver kan ligge dag, aften, nat og weekend
  • Relevant erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område er et krav
  • Straffe- og børneattest skal kunne godkendes
  • Relevante referencer indhentes inden opstart
  • Dokumentation for uddannelse og kvalifikationer skal foreligge Er du den fagperson

Lyder MerCare som et sted for dig?
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi beskriver, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være den, der kan mest.

Det handler om at være den medarbejder, der passer til opgaven – og som vi trygt kan sende ud.

Vi matcher ikke bare opgaver.

Vi matcher mennesker. Er du den fagperson

MerCare
Skabt af praksis – båret af ansvar.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

Your tasks & responsibilities 
Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately


Your profile & qualifications
 
You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:

  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
Underviser søges til varmtvandstræning i Favrskov Kommune

LOF Midtjylland søger en engageret underviser til varmtvandstræning i Hammel og Hinnerup i Favrskov Kommune. Vi ønsker at oprette nye hold, hvor deltagerne får mulighed for at arbejde med bevægelse, styrke, balance og mobilitet i skånsomme rammer.

Som underviser skal du kunne tilrettelægge undervisningen, så øvelserne kan tilpasses deltagernes forskellige behov og forudsætninger. Det er vigtigt for os, at deltagerne oplever både faglighed, tryghed og et godt fællesskab på holdet.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har erfaring med bevægelse, træning, fysioterapi, idræt eller lignende

  • er tryg ved at undervise grupper

  • kan tilpasse øvelser til forskellige niveauer og fysiske forudsætninger

  • er imødekommende og god til at skabe en tryg stemning

  • har interesse for folkeoplysning og for at gøre bevægelse tilgængelig for flere

Erfaring med varmtvandstræning er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har de rette faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Der er tale om timebaseret undervisning på et eller flere hold. Du ansættes som timelønnet underviser hos LOF Midtjylland og aflønnes efter gældende løncirkulære for folkeoplysningen. Vi planlægger holdene til forårssæsonen 2027.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send en mail til job@lof-midtjylland.dk og fortæl kort om dig selv, din erfaring og din motivation.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Anisette Bjerringholm på mail: Anisette@lof-midtjylland.dk eller tlf: 93394544.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bh LOF Midtjylland

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced craftsman with a passion for traditional craftsmanship and decorative work?

We are a Danish construction company specialising in high-end properties, historic and listed buildings, and projects that require a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

We are looking for an experienced façade decorator, stucco worker or specialist mason with proven experience in decorative façade work and traditional building techniques.

The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working with cornices, mouldings, ornaments, decorative façades, stucco and detailed plasterwork, and will know how to recreate and restore decorative features with the precision and quality required when working on historic and architecturally significant buildings.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional bricklayer. What is most important to us is that you are highly skilled in your craft and have genuine experience with decorative and ornamental work carried out using traditional methods.

We are looking for someone who:

● Has solid and documented experience in façade decoration, stucco work or specialist masonry

● Has experience working on historic, older or listed buildings

● Is experienced in traditional techniques and materials

● Has a strong eye for detail, proportions and high-quality finishes

● Is able to work independently and take responsibility for the quality of their work

● Understands and respects the original architecture of historic buildings

● Can provide professional references and preferably photographs of previous projects

What we offer

You will become part of a professional team working on exclusive and unique properties and projects where traditional craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging and interesting projects where your experience and specialist skills are genuinely appreciated.

Salary will be negotiated according to qualifications and experience.

If you have the experience, craftsmanship and passion for the details that make a difference, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Please send us a short application, CV and, if possible, photographs and references from previous work.

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing the possibility of you joining our team.

Contact us for an informal conversation about the position.

Best regards, Ali

jobs.title: Experienced Massage Therapist – AIRE Ancient Baths Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:
Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each.

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols.

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock.

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols.

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience!

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182DKK

  • Permanent Contract and Working Hours: You will have a permanent contract with 20 hours per week

  • Working days: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips.

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected.

Copenhagen location
You will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About AIRE:

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.

At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Upper East Side and Toronto facilities in 2024.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

Preparazione della linea: predisposizione bobine/rocchetti, caricamento materie prime (conduttori, isolanti/guaina), set-up base e cambio formato seguendo le istruzioni del conduttore. Avviamento e conduzione in affiancamento: supporto durante start/stop, controllo che il materiale scorra correttamente, segnalazione anomalie (strappi, fuori misura, difetti superficiali). Controlli qualità in linea: verifiche semplici e registrazioni (es. diametro/spessore, continuità visiva, etichettatura, lunghezze), con eventuale isolamento del non conforme. Gestione bobine e movimentazione: sostituzione bobine finite, predisposizione nuove bobine, imballo/legatura, identificazione lotti e tracciabilità (etichette/ordine di produzione). Pulizia e manutenzione ordinaria: riordino post-lavorazione, pulizia area e componenti, piccole attività di routine (lubrificazione/controlli base) e segnalazione guasti alla manutenzione. Sicurezza e procedure: uso DPI, rispetto procedure HSE, attenzione a parti in movimento e carichi; collaborazione nel passaggio consegne tra turni. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza pregressa in linea di produzione Affidabilità e precisione. Attenzione a sicurezza, qualità e ordine. Spirito di collaborazione e rispetto delle regole. jobs.title: Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;
• Are fluent in English and French and/or German;
• Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,800 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 370,000 people in 149 countries. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting we help build, accelerate and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821206) U ODJELU STROJARSKOG ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – strojarskog ili metalskog smjera • 2 godine radnog iskustva • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• sudjeluje u svim monterskim radovima na terenu i u radionici; izmjeni crpnih agregata, izmjeni zaporno - regulacijske armature (zasuni, hidrostopovi, leptirice ručne i elektro-mot.), rekonstrukcije cijelih strojarnica, komora, objekata, generalnih popravaka crpnih agregata, kompresora i ostalih strojeva, utovar i istovar crpnih agregata i ostale opreme uz pomoć dizalice na kamion • sudjeluje u izmjeni, montaži i demontaži svih vrsta cijevnih instalacija, ventila, uređaja i opreme vezane uz objekte crpljenja • vrši izradu raznih konstrukcija, pomoćnih naprava, bravarskih radova na izradi fazonskih komada, upora i sl. • samostalno izvodi popravke i remonte crpnih agregata i ostalih pomoćnih uređaja manjih kapaciteta i gabarita • po potrebi, sudjeluje u radovima na održavanju hidroforskih postrojenja • obavezan je odazvati se na poziv dispečera poradi intervencije i izvan radnog vremena

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja)

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821306) U ODJELU ELEKTRO ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – elektro smjera • 2 godine radnog iskustva • poznavanje čitanja električnih shema • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• obavlja složene poslove na održavanju elektro opreme i uređaja energetike na crpnim, precrpnim stanicama i vodospremama • obavlja popravak elemenata električnih instalacija niskog napona, sklopne tehnike, rasvjete, grijanja i snage • sudjeluje pri remontu agregata, demontaže i montaže elektro motora, mekih upuštača, frekventnih pretvarača i ispravljača • obavlja izradu električnih instalacija jake i slabe struje • izrađuje i montira sustave za kompenzaciju jalove energije na svim pogonima vodoopskrbe • održava elektroinstalacije u poslovnim prostorima • popravlja i održava vanjsku i unutarnju rasvjetu, gromobransku instalaciju, uzemljenja, izjednačavanje potencijala i kabelskog razvoda • rad u smjenama

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Permanent employment with a global and growing logistics leader
* Salary: PLN 91,663 – 145,800 gross per year*
* Private medical care (LUX MED)
* Group life insurance
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting employees and their families
* Employment contract in an international logistics company

The final salary level will depend on the candidate's professional experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Montagehelfer*in/Montagemitarbeiter*in (W/M/D) (Helfer/in - Metallbau)
jobs.description:
Die HaKu Service GmbH ist Teil der schwedischen ViaCon Group, deren Geschäftsfeld sich in zwei verschiedene Bereiche unterteilt ist: Brücken und Durchlässe (Business Area 1) sowie Regenwassersysteme und geotechnische Anwendungsgebiete (Business Area 2).

Die HaKu Service GmbH führt Montagearbeiten im Bereich Brücken und Durchlässe (BA 1) aus.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir derzeit einen Montagehelfer / Montagemitarbeiter (m/w/d).

Der Montagehelfer / Montagemitarbeiter ist verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Montage- und Installationsarbeiten an Produkten und Lösungen der ViaCon Group, insbesondere im Bereich BA 1, unter Einhaltung technischer Vorgaben, geltender Sicherheitsvorschriften und projektbezogener Zeitpläne.

Zu den Aufgaben gehören die Vorbereitung und Handhabung von Materialien, Werkzeugen und Bauteilen, die Durchführung von Montagearbeiten vor Ort im In- und Ausland sowie – sofern erforderlich – das Arbeiten nach technischen Zeichnungen und Anweisungen. Der Montagehelfer / Montagemitarbeiter trägt zu einer termingerechten, sicheren und qualitativ hochwertigen Umsetzung der Projekte bei und arbeitet eng mit dem Montageteam sowie relevanten internen Schnittstellen zusammen.

Hauptaufgaben:

- Unterstützung bei Montage- und Demontagearbeiten im Bereich BA 1
- Vorbereitung von Materialien, Werkzeugen und Bauteilen für die Montage
- Unterstützung beim Aufbau, Einbau und der Befestigung von Bauteilen und Konstruktionen
- Durchführung allgemeiner unterstützender Tätigkeiten auf Baustellen und an Einsatzorten
- Be- und Entladen von Materialien und Werkzeugen
- Durchführung von Fahrten zu Einsatzorten, sofern erforderlich
- Unterstützung bei Wartungs-, Service- und Reparaturarbeiten
- Sicherstellung von Sauberkeit, Ordnung und Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Monteuren und dem zuständigen Team

Wichtige Anforderungen:

- Erfahrung im Bereich Montage ist erforderlich
- Fähigkeit zum Lesen technischer Zeichnungen ist von Vorteil
- Erfahrung in der Bedienung von Hebebühnen und Staplern ist von Vorteil
- Bereitschaft zu Montageeinsätzen im In- und Ausland (in projektbedingten Ausnahmefällen auch am Wochenende)
- Gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für die EU
- Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B erforderlich

Dein Profil:

- Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Grundverständnis
- Körperliche Belastbarkeit sowie eine qualitätsbewusste und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
- Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
- Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Arbeitszeit:

ca. 45 Stunden pro Woche

Wir bieten:

- attraktive und faire Vergütung, die je nach Art des Einsatzes in drei verschiedene Lohnstufen unterteilt ist
- Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem praxisnahen Arbeitsumfeld
- Hochwertige Arbeitskleidung und Arbeitsschutzausrüstung
- Einsätze in einem motivierten Team
- Faire und transparente Vergütungsstruktur
- Beschäftigung in einem verbundenen Unternehmen des ViaCon Konzerns
- Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Montage weiter auszubauen
- Firmenrad-Leasing
- Firmenfitness über Wellpass

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Neueinbau, Transport, Lagerarbeit, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Beladen, Entladen, Hebezeuge bedienen, Leichtmetallbau, Metallbau, Nieten, Blechbearbeitung, Schweißen, Rohrinstallation, Bohren, Maschineneinrichtung, Anlageneinrichtung, Wartung, Reparatur, Instandhaltung, Blechschweißen, Oberflächen behandeln, veredeln, Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung, Maschinenführung, Anlagenführung, -bedienung, Rohrleitungsbau, Metallbearbeiten, Metallverarbeiten, Qualitätskontrolle (einfache Kontrolltätigkeit)
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Montage (Metall, Anlagenbau), Baugruppenmontage, Anlagenbau

jobs.description:
Máte zkušenosti s účetnictvím, rádi máte čísla i procesy pod kontrolou a chcete mít možnost ovlivnit fungování firmy? Přidejte se k nám do Auto Dobrovolný.

Kdo jsme?
Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí a třemi provozovnami ve Velkém Meziříčí, Jihlavě a Znojmě. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAP motor a poskytujeme stabilní zázemí pro tým přibližně 90 zaměstnanců.

Co vás u nás čeká?
Převezmete odpovědnost za ekonomický úsek a kompletní účetnictví společnosti. Součástí role bude také vedení a metodická podpora týmu 4 účetních.
Čeká vás zejména:

-    kompletní vedení účetnictví včetně DPH a DPPO,
-    odpovědnost za měsíční a roční účetní uzávěrky,
-    vedení a koordinace účetního týmu,
-    příprava podkladů pro auditora a daňového poradce a komunikace s úřady,
-    evidence dlouhodobého majetku, odpisů a inventarizací,
-    tvorba ekonomických přehledů, reportů a analýz pro vedení,
-    nastavování a optimalizace účetních a ekonomických procesů,
-    pokročilá práce v Excelu.

Budete u důležité změny
Aktuálně implementujeme nový účetní systém a hledáme člověka, který projekt aktivně převezme a pomůže nastavit procesy pro každodenní fungování.
Oceníme proto technickou zdatnost, procesní myšlení a chuť hledat praktická řešení. S interními procesy a systémem Softapp vás postupně seznámíme, abyste plynule převzal/a veškerou agendu.

Koho hledáme?

-    minimálně 5 let praxe na pozici hlavní nebo samostatné účetní,
-    výbornou znalost českých účetních a daňových předpisů,
-    zkušenost s účetními uzávěrkami,
-    velmi dobrou znalost MS Excel a účetních systémů,
-    schopnost vést tým, organizovat práci a nastavovat procesy,
-    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost,
-    řidičský průkaz sk. B.
Výhodou bude zkušenost s implementací či digitalizací účetních systémů a komunikací s auditory nebo daňovými poradci.

Co Vám nabídneme?
-    stabilní práci v rodinné firmě s dlouholetou tradicí,
-    flexibilní pracovní dobu,
-    podnikovou jídelnu s příspěvkem na stravu,
-    5 sick days ročně,
-    vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce,
-    výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servis,
-    možnost ovlivnit nastavení ekonomických procesů a fungování firmy.
Chcete mít ekonomiku firmy ve svých rukou a vidět výsledky své práce? Pošlete nám svůj životopis – rádi vás poznáme.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEERING

 - Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

 - Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

 - Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

 - Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.
   


SECURE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

 - Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

 - Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM tools (Wiz, Lacework, Prisma, Orca, SCC, etc.).

 - Deep expertise in GCP security (IAM, VPC, KMS, GKE, Cloud Logging).

 - Experience securing and governing SaaS platforms and identity integrations.

 - Operational experience with infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud and container environments.

 - Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services and configurations.

 - Experience with container and Kubernetes security across GKE, EKS, or AKS.

 - Strong IaC security experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tooling.

 - Familiarity with compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience supporting engineering teams in building secure-first, cloud-native or PaaS environments.

 - Background securing AI/ML pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or developer platform services.

 - Experience in high-growth technology or cloud-native product companies.

 - Experience with securing AI/agentic systems and sensitive data pipelines.

 - Automation/scripting with Python.

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS/Azure security certs).
   
   


WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset — Ability to break down complex security and operational challenges into clear engineering solutions.

 - Autonomy — Comfortable leading initiatives, collaborating effectively,  and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Communication excellence — Able to translate deep technical concepts for engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.

 - Continuous learning — Passion for staying current with AI security, cloud-native advances, and emerging threats.

 - Automation-first approach — Belief in reducing operational toil and building scalable, self-healing systems.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

jobs.description:
At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about regulation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Regulatory Counsel. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Regulatory Counsel is a mid-level role within the Regulatory function, responsible for providing independent regulatory advice and analysis to the business across multiple gambling jurisdictions.

The Regulatory Counsel takes ownership of a defined portfolio of regulatory matters, providing clear and practical advice on the application of gambling laws, licence conditions, and regulatory requirements.

The role involves independent management of licensing and regulatory submissions, proactive identification of regulatory risks, and substantive input into the development of policies, frameworks, and business initiatives. The Regulatory Counsel will develop relationships with internal stakeholders and regulators, contributing meaningfully to the delivery of the team’s objectives.

Accountabilities:

Regulatory Advisory & Interpretation

    Monitor, analyse and interpret regulatory developments across multiple gambling jurisdictions, assessing their impact on the business.
    Provide clear, practical, and independent regulatory advice to internal stakeholders across product, marketing, payments, operations, and technology.
    Conduct substantive legal research and regulatory analysis on applicable laws, licence conditions, and regulatory frameworks.
    Manage regulatory queries from the business, providing timely and well-reasoned responses with limited supervision.
    Provide regulatory input on customer-facing terms and conditions, complaints, and related matters.
    Identify and escalate novel, complex, or high-risk regulatory issues to the Senior Regulatory Counsel as appropriate.

Regulatory Strategy & Business Enablement

    Lead regulatory impact assessments in connection with new products, features, market entries, and strategic initiatives.
    Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory risks, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
    Drive cross-functional engagement to support the embedding of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Provide substantive regulatory guidance on AML/CFT, sanctions, responsible gambling, data protection, and other key regulatory areas.
    Support the Senior Regulatory Counsel in providing regulatory input into the business’s strategic planning and commercial activities.

Licensing & Regulatory Operations

    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Oversee and ensure compliance with regulatory reporting obligations, including timely and accurate submissions to licensing authorities.
    Maintain and develop regulatory registers, licences, approvals, and associated documentation.
    Manage and develop relationships with regulators and competent authorities, escalating significant regulatory interactions to the Senior Regulatory Counsel.
    Prepare and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, inspections, enforcement actions, and information requests.

Regulatory Framework & Policy Development

    Assist in the development and maintenance of assigned regulatory policies, standards, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with applicable laws and licence conditions.
    Provide substantive regulatory input into AML, responsible gambling, consumer protection, and other regulatory policy areas.
    Develop and deliver regulatory training and awareness materials to Compliance and operational teams.
    Identify gaps in existing policies and frameworks and propose improvements proactively.

Governance, Assurance & Collaboration

    Provide meaningful regulatory input into compliance monitoring activities, internal reviews, and audit processes.
    Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and operational teams to ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Lead or contribute to regulatory workstreams within internal projects, change program, and cross-functional initiatives.
    Support junior members of the Regulatory team, providing guidance and reviewing their work where required.

Documentation & General

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, records, and internal registers.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory function’s processes and ways of working.
    Perform other duties reasonably aligned with the role.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    3–4 years post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, ideally within iGaming, fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Exposure to AML/CFT, responsible gambling, and consumer protection regulatory requirements is required.
    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language (Danish, Finnish, or Swedish) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Confident and credible in providing independent regulatory advice, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
    Commercially aware and solution-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to regulatory challenges.
    Proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to developing deep expertise in international gambling regulation.
    Collaborative and effective in building relationships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Employee benefits
